The Bramble Plateau is a rock formation overlooking the Northwatch Descent. One of the pylons powering the Northwatch tower is located there.

== Getting there ==
It is normally reached during Use the Priory's "Bramble Begone" rifle to clear vines and reach Bramble Plateau as part of the chain to activate the pylon located there. Alternatively you can reach this POI if you have advanced gliding, by first going to the "Straight and Narrow" Strongbox and then a quick jump North, run up the tree branch protruding East, and just glide across.
If you only have the Lean Techniques mastery, you can follow the guide above and fall to a platform just short of and below the landing, then glide against the outside wall to tag it. This method is similar to tagging the Versoconjouring Waypoint in Malch
The Capitzel Grounds is a hylek village located in the Tarnished Treetop, and home to members of both the Coztic and Xocotl tribes.
The Quazupl Grounds are home to a group of Coztic and Xocotl hylek.

The Weeping Glade is a grove home to a group of Bristlebacks. It's a set of 2 shallow ponds formed by waterfalls flowing down a slope,
with tree roots above each forming shapes resembling eyes, giving the area its name.

The Inner Chamber of Tarir, the Forgotten City is where Glint's egg is kept stored by the Exalted. It is also the location of the Egg Bearer Jumping Puzzle around the outside of the chamber.

== Getting there ==
There is an Exalted Portal to Inner Chamber located near where you can jump down from the  Forgotten City Waypoint — . Drop down and head east. Follow the tunnel to the right and down. As of the April 19th, 2016 update, this area is open to anyone with the Exalted Markings mastery.
The Jawatl Grounds were once the home of a group of Nuhoch hylek. The village was overrun by Mordrem and almost everyone were slain.

Masks of the Fallen is where the Exalted take the masks belonging to killed Exalted to rest. It is the closest thing to a cemetery they have.

== Getting there ==
To get to this Point of Interest, players will need Exalted Acceptance. Go to the  Forgotten City Waypoint — , walk north through the gate to the northern quadrant of the city. Turn northwest and go all the way to the corner of the quadrant. On the northwest wall is a staircase going up (facing southwest). Go up the first set of stairs and through the corridor on the left. It makes a slight jog to the right. Just past the jog, in an alcove on the right, there will be two Exalted NPCs with the Adventure icon above their heads. Speak to either of them to enter the adventure area. Go a little further ahead to claim the Point of Inte
The Eastgate is the eastern entry of Tarir.
The Legacy Pillars serves as the main plaza of Tarir, the Forgotten City.
New Skrittington is a scratch located near the tower of Westwatch Patch. It was built by skritt who survived the attack on the Pact fleet.
The Endurance Crash Site is the remnant of the Endurance, an airship that was part of the Pact fleet that went into the Heart of Maguuma.
The Westgate is the western entry of Tarir.

The Vinetooth Den is a large cave home to a group of Mordrem vinetooths as well as the leader of their pack, the Legendary Vinetooth Prime.

== Notes ==
An unmarked glowing pile of remains can be found a few steps due south of the point of interest marker. This is the location of Herta for the Where Exalted Dare achievement.
The Southgate is the southern entry of Tarir.

The Eastwatch Ruins are what's left of the Eastwatch, the eastern watchpost of Tarir, the Forgotten City. According to Sage Korin, it and the other Exalted there were ravaged by a Mordrem Vinetooth leaving Sage Korin as the only survivor, and is now covered in strangling vines. Despite this, the pylons located there still work and are able to be activated.
The Northwatch Priory Camp is a Durmand Priory camp located near the tower located in the Northwatch Descent.
The Fahautl Grounds is the home of the Itzel hylek living in and around The Falls in Auric Basin.
The Sealed Passageway is a hidden tunnel located beneath Tarir, the Forgotten City. It leads to the Gilded Hollow, one of the two guild halls located in the Heart of Maguuma.
The Golden Boughs are a dense forested area with winding paths. When the daylight strikes the foliage, golden highlights can be seen.
The Wreck of the Thunderbreaker is a crashed Pact airship.
The Dwelling of the Kaanas is the home of Kaana Miatli and High Priest Copuul, the joint leaders of Jaka Itzel.
The Wreck of the Mellaggan's Valor is a Pact airship that crashed when the Pact launched their attack on Mordremoth. The airship was named after the quaggan goddess Mellaggan.
The Wreck of the Lethal Vantage is wreckage of a Pact airship found at the Snarled Frontier.

The Temple of Ameyalli is a shrine to the hylek goddess Ameyalli.

== Getting there ==
Go to the location of the POI on the map. It will show that it is underground. Then, go a bit south and turn right. You will see an entrance to a cavern with a lantern beside it, go inside the cavern, and follow the tunnel. The tunnel will lead to the Temple of Ameyalli
The entrance to the Temple of Ameyalli.
The Precarious Ruin is a ruin leading to the Lost Precipice, one of the two guild halls located in the Heart of Maguuma.

The Fumerol Caves are a cave system infested with fungus.

== Notes ==
Prior to Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns' release, this point of interest was named Utogi's Archive.

The Corpse Grove is a desolate land teeming with dangerous Mordrem. Pustules can be seen growing on the trees and vines.

== Getting there ==
Follow the path from Mellaggan's Valor Waypoint to the east and north down the cliffside. Next to one of the switchbacks, there is a huge dark branch which leads into this area.

== Notes ==
Contains the Blighting Tree to kill for the Nevermore I: Ravenswood Branch collection item, Protector of Verdance.
Contains a place to distill an Essence of Mordremoth for the Frostfang I: The Experimental Axe collection item, Distilled Essence of Mordremoth.

Coztic Itzel is a hylek village in Coztic Grounds. It is populated by members of the hostile Coztic tribe who attack any trespassers on sight.

== Getting there ==
Coztic Itzel can be approached by foot, from the northeast. This is not preferred as it requires running past or killing a number of Coztic Itzel. It can also be approached using gliding. From the ledge below Faren's Flyer, one can glide above the point of interest and drop into the village from above.
The Batrach Falls are a set of waterfalls located near Jaka Itzel.
The Brooding Gulch is a canyon used by wyverns to lay eggs.
The Shaded Spring is a Pact camp made up of predominately Vigil members located in the Stonetwist Paths.

Pact Encampment Waypoint may refer to:
The waypoint in Stonetwist paths, in Verdant Brink.
The waypoint in Nave of Arah, inside the Ruined City of Arah dungeon.

Holdfast Hollow is a small cave located in the Broken Bluffs where a small group of Pact members have regrouped upon the destruction of their airship.

== Getting there ==
The entrance to the cave where it is located can be seen between two pieces of wrecked airship, northeast of the point icon for the cave. Go to the left after running through the gap in the wreckage.
The Waking Tomb is large pit filled with jungle tendrils located in the Shrouded Ruins. The adventure Salvage Pit takes place inside the tomb.
The Glory's Fall is a point of interest located in the Canopy over Pact Encampment. It is the location of the wreck of The Glory of Tyria, the flagship of the Pact air fleet.
The Dust Dancer Plateau is a rock formation found in the Thistlevine Ravine. Dust Mites can be found in large number there.

Uprooted Paradise is a landmass that has been pushed skyward, and is being supported by large twisting vines underneath. The Flying Circus Adventure can be found here.

== Getting there ==
From the  Mellaggan's Valor Waypoint — , head north west towards the bouncing mushroom. Use it to reach the area and run west to reach the point of interest.
The Creaking Caverns are a cave system home to dangerous subterranean foes.
The Tangle is a large mass of vines found in the Creeping Crevasse.
Bongo's Bungalow is the camp of Bongo the One-Eyed and Pact soldiers under his command.

River of Spirits is a point of interest within Spirit Vale. Faint ghostly screams can be heard from the river. The river is characterized by a ghostly blue color and the occasional humanoid form moving within its flow. The river seems to flow towards Gorseval's Perch. Any players attempting to enter the River of Spirits will be killed after a short warning.
Although only this Point of Interest is labelled as the River of Spirits; the river itself seems to spread throughout most of Spirit Vale, going as far as The Skillet.
An event takes place on the shore nearby this Point of Interest where players need to close Spectral Rifts while under pressure from multiple foes.

== Foes ==
Ghosts
Angered Spirit
Deranged Spirit
Enraged Spirit

Abandoned Outpost is a point of interest within Spirit Vale. It is located across the bridge from the entrance to the Spirit Woods. The area hold multiple spirit foes upon first arriving. Additionally there is a Hidden chest located on top of a pillar as well as one below the balcony. The torch used for the Keep the Lights On achievement can be found here.
An abandoned fire-pit can be seen in the area, along with a few other hints showing this area was somewhat recently deserted before being occupied by the ghosts.
The Skillet is a point of interest within Spirit Vale. It is a wooden platform guarded by Sabetha the Saboteur, the third and final boss within Spirit Vale.

Mysterious Pylons is a point of interest within Spirit Vale. The pylons are colored Red, Green, and Blue; the three primary colors. The color of these three pylons is reflected in the vale division foes (Red, Green, and Blue guardians). The Vale Guardian, the first boss within Spirit Vale, guards the pylons.
The Mysterious Pylons area features a circular arena where the players can fight the Vale Guardian. Near each colored pylon is a stone plaque with the numbers 1, 2, or 3 written in New Krytan. These stone plaques show both the location of where Seekers will spawn throughout the encounter, and additionally serve to classify the arena into three zones.

== Foes ==
Elemental
Blue Guardian
Green Guardian
Red Guardian
Vale Guardian (boss)

== Notes ==
Bandit's Rest is a Point of Interest within Spirit Vale. There are a number of gravestones in this area.

Gorseval's Perch is a point of interest within Spirit Vale. It is a large round platform guarded by Gorseval the Multifarious, the second boss within Spirit Vale. The River of Spirits flows around platform and a coalescence of spirits can be seen above the platform.
Slothasor's Den is a point of interest within Salvation Pass. Slothasor, the first boss within Salvation Pass, inhabits this cave.
The Prison Camp is a point of interest within Salvation Pass. The encounter against the three bandit champions occurs here.
The Temple of Salvation is a point of interest within Salvation Pass. The encounter against Matthias Gabrel occurs here.

The Burn Pit is a point of interest within Salvation Pass. Two bandit tents overlook a burning pit where bodies have been incinerated.

== Trivia ==
Approaching the Burn Pit will cause your character to cough violently.
Dead Man's Gorge is a Point of Interest within Salvation Pass. The bodies of Krytan citizens are scattered at the bottom of the cliffs on the south-eastern side of the gorge.
The Labor Camp is a point of interest within Salvation Pass.

The Temple of Awakening is a point of interest within Stronghold of the Faithful. It is accessible after defeating Xera. The chamber appears to be misted with blood and prominently features a Stasis Chamber at its center.

Zealot's Bastion is a point of interest within Stronghold of the Faithful. It is where the Keep Construct is fought, and is the entrance to the Twisted Castle following its death.

== Notes ==
The ceiling is intact and the back door closed until the Keep Construct is destroyed.

Tunnel of Respite is a point of interest within Stronghold of the Faithful. Multiple mushroom creatures inhabit this tunnel. Players standing inside the tunnel will get the  Toxic Spores applied to them.

== Trivia ==
The sign at the entrance of the tunnel reads "quicksand" in New Krytan.

Twisted Castle is a point of interest within Stronghold of the Faithful. It is the twisted and warped ruins of a castle ripped apart by Xera's magic. Upon entry, the ambience turns from bright and sunny to dark, brooding and malevolent with eerie purple lighting and roiling clouds. Players must traverse this maze to reach Xera.

== Trivia ==
The Twisted Castle is likely inspired by both  M. C. Escher and The Inverted Castle
Fountain of Cleansing is a Point of Interest within Stronghold of the Faithful. The fountain is found in the center of a richly decorated courtyard.
The Warden's Office is a rectangular room in which the third boss, Samarog, rests within Bastion of the Penitent.
Solitary Confinement is the platform on which the fourth and final boss, Deimos, is encountered in Bastion of the Penitent.
Escape Tunnel is a passage adjacent to Death Row in Bastion of the Penitent.
Cairn's Perch is a platform on which Cairn the Indomitable rests, the first of the bosses within Bastion of the Penitent.
Mystic Waters is a waterfall in which players can collect Celestial Dash before fighting the first boss, Cairn the Indomitable, in Bastion of the Penitent.
Chamber of the Guilty is a pitch black room discovered after defeating Deimos. Here, the raiders listen to the events leading up to Saul D'Alessio's imprisonment.
Confessional is a torture room revealed after defeating Deimos, containing several torture devices.
Located in Bastion of the Penitent, Tree of Solitude is a tree, noted by the Pact Commander, as being a testament to how life can even grow in the most unforgiving areas.
Recreation Sector is a medium-sized, tiled room in which the second boss, Mursaat Overseer, is located within Bastion of the Penitent.
Death Row is a prison which has degraded over time in Bastion of the Penitent.
Spurbend Canyon is a point of interest in the Prospect Valley. This canyon is the stampeding ground of Three-Toed Tootsie.
Flatland Wastes is a point of interest in the Prospect Valley. This huge sand plain separates the Crash Site from the Town of Prosperity.
Choke Canyon is a point of interest in the Prospect Valley. This canyon is home to many arid devourers.

Ship's Fall is a point of interest in the Prospect Valley. Situated high on the cliffs of the Prospect Valley, more ruins of Zephyrite ships can be found surrounded by the Inquest.

== Getting there ==
Begin from Dry Top Entry Waypoint and use the introductory Aspect crystals to head west. Follow the terrain in a sweeping U-turn until you have reached a gap -- you will encounter and use two air crystals prior to reaching this point -- then use the lightning crystal to jump across. From there, use air crystals to scale the tall cliff on your right.
Crash Site 1 is a point of interest in the Prospect Valley. This is where one of the Zephyrite ship landed after it was sabotaged. Many inquest members can be found around the wreckage.
Salamander's Rise is a point of interest in the Prospect Valley. This plateau is home to a Salamander Drake Broodmother and her flock.
Sparring Rock is a point of interest in the Prospect Valley. This lone rock is the training ground of the hermit hylek Nochtli.

The Abandoned Mine is a point of interest in the Prospect Valley. This mine originally belonged to the Town of Prosperity until they discovered an underground magic river. The Inquest have now moved in to study it further, capturing and imprisoning Zephyrites within the impromptu laboratory.

== Notes ==
Entry into the Abandoned Mine is blocked off until the event Rescue the captive Zephyrites occurs. If the event is successful, it will stay open for Defeat the champion N4-SR before the Inquest can lock down their base as well.

Lair of the Beast is a point of interest in the Prospect Valley. This cave is home to the Colocal Queen and her flock.
You get to the Lair of the Beast point of interest from the north and head straight to it on the surface level.

Prosperity Mine is a point of interest in the Prospect Valley. This mine is primarily used for its copper. 

== Getting there ==
The entry to the area is via a mine/cave entrance to the immediate east of the Town of Prosperity. Easiest access is to go to the "eastern" crossing of the deadly sands, proceed north, then immediately turn right at the mine cart and rails.

Town of Prosperity is a point of interest in Dry Top in the Prospect Valley as well as a small mining town located in the northwest of Prospect Valley. Most of its inhabitants were miners working at the Prosperity Mine until the destruction of the town with few residents surviving Mordremoth's attack. The town both serves as a shield from the strong sandstorm outside and as a haven for any hurt Zephyrites. It is also the place where Scarlet Briar spent her early days as an engineer, in a room she rented for her various experiments and planning.

== Trivia ==
The sign just across from the town is written in a stylized form of New Krytan, stating "Quicksand".

Omadd's Machine is a point of interest at the west end of the Cavern of the Shining Lights. This particular area holds a greater concentration of ley line activity. It is the place where Headmaster Omadd had constructed his machine to interact with the ley lines and where the sylvari Ceara had witnessed the Eternal Alchemy itself. The machine still hums with activity.

== Dialogue ==
After waiting a few seconds in front of Omadd's Machine, with Astralaria I: The Device unlocked
After searching around the machine, you find some notes hidden in a crevice.
 Take them. (gives Omadd's Lost Notes)
 Leave.

== Related achievements ==
 Astralaria I: The Device: Omadd's Lost Notes — Search Omadd's Machine within the Cavern of Shining Lights of Dry Top to find his notes.
 HOPE III: Prototype: Omadd'

Ley Line Hub is a massive cave within Dry Top where many Ley lines intersect. Headmaster Omadd made this area his refuge, building his machine where miners stumbled across the hub.

== Getting there ==
Head east from  Crash Site 3 — . Drop down into the gully and follow it south/down toward a set of double doors.

Restoration Refuge is a point of interest located in Treadrock Uplands in Dry Top. This village is inhabited by the Maguuma centaur tribe.

== Getting there ==
Start from Prosperity Waypoint in Prospect Valley and travel through Scarlet's house on the west side of town. Scarlet's Secret Room will lead players here upon completion.
Azarr's Arbor is a point of interest in Uplands Oasis. This pit is used by Azarr Softhoof to plant his vine bridges.

Cragrock Palace is a skritt stronghold in Unswept Uplands. Queen Chrii'kkt IV and her royal subjects reside here.

== Notes ==
This is one of two known locations where a Rich Quartz Crystal Formation is found, the other being in the area above Glint's Legacy
The area can only be accessed after Defeat Queen Chrii'kkt IV and her royal subjects has begun; in other words, when Favor of the Zephyrites reaches Tier 4. The POI can still be obtained by walking up against the closed door, no matter what progress the map is in.
Oasis is a point of interest in Uplands Oasis. The centaurs of the Maguuma tribe are trying their best to keep this place under constant rain.
Crash Site 2 is the location of a second Zephyrite airship wreck in Dry Top.
Raptor Prowl is a point of interest located in Treadrock Uplands. Like the name suggests, this canyon is heavily populated by Vulture Raptors.
An Inquest Base serves as a point of interest in Challenger Cliffs. The Inquest has set up camp there to study the Zephyrites' aspects for their golem prototypes.

Repair Station is an encampment to the far western edge of Dry Top, housing more survivors from the crash of the Zephyrites. It is accessible from Uplands Oasis by a second vine bridge south of Azarr's Arbor.
Crash Site 3 is the location of a third Zephyrite airship wreck in Dry Top.

The Labyrinth is the very heart of an underground maze of vines. It is accessible after the Mordrem Vinewrath has been defeated as well as during the Living World Season 2 story instance Into the Labyrinth.

== Related achievements ==
 Nevermore III: The Raven Staff: Chase the Spirit from the Labyrinth — Use the Subtle Spyglass with the Spirit Containment Unit in your inventory to see the true nature of the raven at the center of the Labyrinth in the Silverwastes.
 Twilight III: Dusk: Tangled Darkness — Use the Gloominator to capture the darkness in the center of the Tangled Labyrinth in the Silverwastes.

== See also ==
Key of Greater Nightmares
Wingspan Arch is a point of interest in Southeastern Silverwastes. This natural rock formation is found just between Red Rock Bastion and the Indigo Cave.
Red Rock Bastion is a point of interest in Southeastern Silverwastes. It is one of the four forts held by the Pact in The Silverwastes.

Camp Resolve is an area in the Silverwastes. It serves as the Pact rally point for their airborne assault on Mordremoth.

== Locations and objectives ==
Waypoints
 Camp Resolve Waypoint — 
Points of interest
 Camp Resolve — 
 Fugitive's Claim — 
Vistas
 Camp Resolve Vista — 
Warp to Camp Resolve Waypoint, head towards the vista, go up the stairs.

Indigo Cave is a point of interest in Central Silverwastes. It is one of the four forts held by the Pact in The Silverwastes. Champion Mordrem Teragriff Gold and Champion Mordrem Teragriff Silver spawn beneath it during The Breach.
Amber Sandfall is a point of interest in Southwestern Silverwastes. It is one of the four forts held by the Pact in The Silverwastes.
Blue Oasis is a point of interest in Northwestern Silverwastes. It is one of the four forts held by the Pact in The Silverwastes.

SS Topsy-Turvy is a large ship, of unknown origin, hanging in the Skritt cave system in Northeastern Silverwastes. The Skritt are attempting to rebuild it; however they require many extra materials such as "Plankz", "Bordz", "Nailz", "Barrollz" of "Tarz", and "Dekorashunz".

== Task Bord translation ==
The billboard in front of SS Topsy-Turvy, labeled "Task Bord" by the Skritt, contains various lists of items and tasks required to rebuild the ship.
Fugitive's Claim is a point of interest in Camp Resolve. This cave just outside Camp Resolve is home to a small group of earth elementals.

Sand Dune Caverns is a point of interest in The Silverwastes. It is located underground, only accessible from the Retrospective Runaround jumping puzzle.

== Getting there ==
Drop past the sixth milestone of the jumping puzzle (refer to the walkthrough). A Kit will pop up out of the ground to revive players if they die. When done, find and use the skritt tunnel to get back on track. Alternatively players can glide or use a mount, though they will still need to use the Kit to get back to the rest of the jumping puzzle.
Players can run to this POI from the dive achievement pool under the SS Topsy-Turvy.
A skimmer can be used in particular to get to the PoI -- head eastward hanging along the left hand "wall". There is a short opening which you can slide through and the PoI is shortly thereaft

Picaroon Scratch is a point of interest within Northeastern Silverwastes. It is the place where the local skritt in the Silverwastes live. It is the entry to a large cave system below the Silverwastes.

== Getting there ==
The point of interest is not underground. To get here for   Drive the bandits out of skritt territory (80) if the gate's closed, fly (if you have a skyscale) or maneuver up to the higher ledges to a point that is slightly south east (more east than south) of the hero point closest to the orange circle for the event. Once you get there, fly north, under a rock ledge, to find the fight.

== Notes ==
Access to this area was opened with the Seeds of Truth release.
Wailing Sands is a point of interest in Northern Silverwastes. This plain is inhabited primarily by earth elementals.

The Charnel Grounds are the living grounds of the Zintl hylek tribe who, referred to by their captives, are servants of the Sun. They force their prisoners to tend to their Giant Beetles.

== Trivia ==
A charnel ground is an above-ground site for the putrefaction of bodies, generally human, where formerly living tissue is left to decompose uncovered.
Dry Quarry is a pond in the Northern Silverwastes that is home to a small flock of Salamander Drakes and their nests.

Northern Shelf is a point of interest in Northeastern Silverwastes. This place, which seems to be free of Mordrem, is a haven for the local wildlife.

== Getting there ==
Start from the  Camp Resolve Waypoint. Exit the camp through the northwest gate, and bear north once out of the ravine. The point of interest is in the valley near the crashed chopper.

Remnant's Retreat is a point of interest in Northern Silverwastes. This camp is home to a small group of bandits who managed to escape Fort Vandal.

== Notes ==
There is a Champion Bandit Spokesperson located in the narrows leading into this valley. She offers safe passage into the area for 2 gold; otherwise, the bandits will be hostile and you will periodically trigger bleed and cripple traps which deal roughly 15k and add 5-10 stacks of bleed with 10 seconds of cripple.

Vinewrath Tangle is an area in the Silverwastes. The Mordrem Vinewrath, the lieutenant of Mordremoth tasked with taking control of the Silverwastes is found there along with his own champions.This area is normally only accessible during Time Out (meta event), following successful completion of Mordrem Vinewrath.

== Locations and objectives ==
Points of interest
 Vinewrath Tangle — 
Hero challenges
 Fallen Asura

Outlier's Foundry is a point of interest in Sharp Valley that can only be accessed by a Skritt Tunnel found in the Central Silverwastes. It's home to Solus the Outlier, a charr engineer who builds mechanical devourers and Mechanical Devourer Suits.

Freetrader Haven is located at the heart of the Corsair Flotilla in the Domain of Istan. It is where various corsair crews meet to socialize, trade, repair ships and resupply under the rules of parley. However, despite the safety provided by the shared port and the common accord, rival crews occasionally end up insulting one another and brawl to settle their disputes. A tall, wooden clock tower stands at the center of the haven.

== Trivia ==
Pirate haven is a term used for ports or harbors that are safe places for pirates to stop in between raids.

The Dark Leviathan is a corsair ship docking in the Corsair Flotilla in the Domain of Istan. She is helmed by Captain Sayida the Sly of the Sly Crew.

== Trivia ==
The ship's name is likely inspired by the leviathans, massive underwater monsters which inhabit the Unending Ocean and the Sea of Sorrows.
The Temple of Joko is a point of interest in Palawadan, Jewel of Istan in the Domain of Istan.

Mirror of the Sun is one of the four mirrors surrounding The Astralarium in the Domain of Istan.

Mirror of the Moon
Mirror of the Stars
Ancient Royal Docks are located in Churrhir Cliffs and act as a concealed entrance to Fahranur, the First City.

Mirror of the Earth is one of the four mirrors surrounding The Astralarium in the Domain of Istan.

The Sun Docks is a point of interest in Palawadan, Jewel of Istan in the Domain of Istan.
The Broken Observation Tower is a badly damaged tower found to the northern side of The Astralarium in the Domain of Istan.
The Stage of Sacrifice is a point of interest in Palawadan, Jewel of Istan in the Domain of Istan. This stage is situated directly opposite of the Palawadan Dormitories.
Skylight Vault is a point of interest located in the Modri Caverns, very close to the Skyclad Mushrooms required as part of the story step Convincing the Corsair.
Crucible of the Apostate is a point of interest within Heretic's Arena.
The Zehlon Waterworks is a large watermill at a waterfall in the Zehlon Breach.

Grotto of the Defeated is a point of interest in Champion's Dawn, home to the Awakened Koss Dejarin.
There are multiple Mordant Crescent Notices pinned to the walls as you enter the Grotto, reproduced below in order of appearance.
Mordant Crescent Notice 1
Under penalty of re-death, no one is to bring this egotistical, jaw-flapping, showboating blowhard back to the Great Hall. Leave him here to rot in this cave, or you answer to the archon.
 Well, this sounds like a charming fellow.
Mordant Crescent Notice 2
Our patrol went through a lot of trouble to get him to stay here to "guard the cave." Don't ruin this for us!
 Do I dare continue?
Mordant Crescent Notice 3
Seriously. Why are you walking even farther into this cave? TURN BACK NOW!
 Well, now I just have to see this.
Clanmarshal's Promenade is a point of interest in Palawadan, Jewel of Istan in the Domain of Istan.
Plaza of Resurgence is a Point of Interest located in the Mordant Crescent Great Hall. It is protected by several Awakened forces.

Jakumba's Legacy is a massive windmill in the Zehlon Breach.

== Trivia ==
This area is a reference to Master Engineer Jakumba, an Istanni engineer from the original Guild Wars.

The Wobbling Skies is a Corsair airship docking in the Corsair Flotilla. She is crewed by the Alehound Crew and captained by Brewmaster Asef. The Alehounds captured this airship after a drunken raid. Every crew member was so wasted that no one recalls how they obtained her.

== Trivia ==
Based on the airship's appearance and color scheme, she seems to have once belonged to the Aetherblades.

== References ==
Palawadan Dormitories is a point of interest in Palawadan, Jewel of Istan in the Domain of Istan. The interior has many bunk beds arranged radially against the walls.

Mirror of the Moon is one of the four mirrors surrounding The Astralarium in the Domain of Istan.

== See also ==
Mirror of the Earth
Mirror of the Stars
Mirror of the Sun
The Skimming Stone is a Corsair ship docking in the Corsair Flotilla. She is crewed by the Stonefist Crew and helmed by Captain Randa.

Mirror of the Stars is one of the four mirrors surrounding The Astralarium in the Domain of Istan.

== See also ==
Mirror of the Earth
Mirror of the Moon
Mirror of the Sun

Mehtani's Blade is a Corsair ship in Issnur Bay. It is inhabitated by the Accursed Crew under captain Simoom the Accursed.

== Trivia ==
It is named after the Mehtani Keys.
Chahbek Thrust is a ruined village in Churrhir Cliffs. It used to be the training ground of new Sunspears.
The Lahdok Craterlands are a series of tar-filled craters in the Plains of Jarin. Tar Elementals infest these pits.

Hall of Judgment (Domain of Istan)
Hall of Judgment (Hall of Chains)
Field of the Hopeful is a point of interest in Champion's Dawn.

Warden's Quarters is a Point of Interest located in the Mordant Crescent Great Hall. It is protected by several Awakened forces and is only available during final stages of the Sunspear Uprising events at the Great Hall, or via the story instance The Hero of Istan.
Scalding Geyser is a point of interest in Cragged Upland in Lowland Shore. It is a large geyser spewing steam into the sky that inflicts  Fire to anything standing on it.

Tundra Steppe is a point of interest in Cragged Upland in Lowland Shore. It is a relatively-flat, grassy stretch of land, with yellowing grass and few trees. The steppe is home to bees, feral journeykin, reindeer, timber wolves, and various other small animals. Rotling titanspawn can be found here, attacking the native widllife.
Troll's Tailgate is a point of interest in south Coursing Upland in Lowland Shore. It is a large bonfire near the troll den of Bagoo Cave.

Queen's Confidence is a point of interest located in Lowland Shore. It is a large beehive inside a cave. The Queen's Confidence jumping puzzle occurs here.

== Getting there ==
The point of interest is located in the large rock structure south of  Autumn's Vale Waypoint — . It can be reached through a small tunnel underwater hidden by yellow plants in the water north of Amphibian's Knot point of interest (the entrance is almost halfway between Amphibian's Knot and Queen's Confidence).
		

== Related achievements ==
 Lowland Shore: Hive Hopper — Complete the Queen's Confidence jumping puzzle. (1)

The Delta Bifurcation is a point of interest atop the Exorheic Falls. It is a rushing river flowing from Divinity's Falls falling into three massive waterfalls that lead into the rivers of Haar Mire, Autumn's Vale, and Harvest Den. Players swimming on the river's surface or below the water will be pushed toward the waterfalls. This does not affect skimmers hovering atop the water's surface.

The Iboga Burrows are a point of interest in Bjorn Thicket in southeast Lowland Shore. The burrows are situated on a ridge up against a cliff, and are home to a population of invasive ibogas. Though any underground sections of the burrows are inaccessible, a pair of holes in mounds of dirt can be seen on the ridge.
Salmon's Fluttering is a point of interest in Lowland Shore.
Fading Aurora's House is a point of interest located in the Harvest Den. And this site is the home of the Fading Aurora known as Waiting Sorrow.

Lowland Hot Springs is a point of interest located in the east side of Cragged Upland. It is a set of hot springs owned by the lowland kodan Foggy Air, who sometimes requests assistance in helping the guests relax.

== Related achievements ==
 Lowland Shore: Relaxed and Rejuvenated — Relax in the hot springs. (1)
Springer's Peak is a point of interest in Lowland Shore. It is home to wild springers.
Fishing Village Aquarium is a point of interest located in the basement of main fishing village in Autumn's Vale.
Runoff Taint is a point of interest in Lowland Shore.

Divinity's Falls are a massive waterfall behind Moon Camp Covert in south Lowland Shore. They are the source of the water cascading down into Exorheic Falls, flowing into the ocean. The falls derive their name from Divinity's Reach, which they are connected to via an unnamed river.
Stoic Alder's House is a point of interest located in the Harvest Den.  And it is the home of the claw Stoic Alder.

Bagoo Cave is a point of interest in Lowland Shore, against the southern cliffs of the Coursing Upland. It is a cave troll den with a scale of Glint at its center, branches growing around it. The scale is speculated to have been present before the trolls took over the cave.

== Related achievements ==
 Lowland Shore: Friend of the Trolls — Befriend some trolls by using the correct emotes. (1)
 Lowland Shore: Troll Delicacy — Consume a rock cooked by the troll. (0)

== Getting there ==
Starting from  Argo Crawler — , swim to the south-western end of the lake. The entrance to the cave is behind some bushes on the waterline of the lake. Follow the cave until you reach the point of interest.

The Altrumm Mines are amber mines which have supplied Kurzick amber for many generations. The current mining operation has created a very small town with the members of the mining crew. Although amber is not as expensive as jade, the amber from these mines is still sought after by those interested in Kurzick culture. 
There are no other amber mines in service, so all newly mined amber comes from this mine, increasing profitability. The nearby ruins of Altrumm are thought by most historians to be all that remains of the first great Kurzick city, destroyed by some ancient and mysterious catastrophe. The Kurzicks themselves claim their ancestors did not build the structures found there, which would mean that Altrumm influenced Kurzick architectural sensibilities.

The Garenhoff Refugee Camp is a camp populated by mostly human refugees running away from Devastated Garenhoff. It is protected by a small group of Rift Hunters.

The kitchen contains some strange ingredients such as Demonic essence, Bloodstone dust, Cauldron of Blood, etc. Briella will frequently request help preparing bait for the Rift Hunters.
Vass's Compassion is a point of interest within Jade Mech Habitation Zone 03. It is named after the Forgotten Vass of the Wizard's Court.

The Eastern Ward is a section of Lion's Arch. It contains Coriolis Plaza, the newly built asura gate hub to the five racial capitals, as well as The Vaults, the new Black Lion Trading Company Headquarters. The ward is accessed by going east from the Grand Piazza or across the bridge over the Inner Harbor from the Postern Ward.

== Ambient dialogue ==
For previous dialogue, see here.
Edda: I'm taking a chance hiring you. If you weren't so cheap...
Melydiod: I understand.
Edda: My contact in Rata Sum says the parts will arrive next week.
Melydiod: Okay.
Edda: We have to get the storage space ready for it.
Melydiod: Got it.
Edda: And don't forget to fill out the inventory sheet properly this time.

Beacon of Ages Command Center is a point of interest in Wizard's Ascent. As its name indicates, it is the operations center of the Astral Ward, as well as an office where Director Camillus is located and several notes can be found there, as well as a map of ley lines.
The Lyhr's Design is a point of interest within Wizard's Ascent. It is a tower named after dwarf Lyhr.
Fragmented Passage is a cave full of spiders and used as a passageway to access the Cosmic Observatory, it is located within the Stargaze Ridge.

The Dagda's Perception is located within the Cosmic Observatory, on the Stargaze Ridge.

== Notes ==
Can only be accessed inside the observatory during Mother of Stars mission and Strike Mission of Cosmic Observatory.

The Crash of the Storm's Daughter is a point of interest in the Primal Maguuma fractal in Skywatch Archipelago. It is the wreckage of an airship that crashed into north Cloudview Lake and subsequently became overgrown. It was captained by Saia, whose journal can be found on the northeast bank of the lake. She set out to find the source of the ley line fluctuations in the Maguuma Jungle to convince a group of unnamed bureaucrats to act.

The Abandoned Lab is a point of interest within Devastated Garenhoff. Amidst the ruins of Garenhoff can be found this odd bit of incongruous asuran architecture.

== Trivia ==
Normally inaccessible, the lab is part of the Asura personal story.
Western Research Facilities is a point of interest in Rata Novus Promenade. Access is via a teleport from Gate Research Lab.

The Light Crystal is a point of interest within the Rata Novus Promenade.

== Getting there ==
Go to the Rata Novus Promenade Waypoint  Rata Novus Promenade Waypoint —  and go immediately to the right, towards the point of interest. You need not fight anything, just walk/fly towards the point and if you are not already flying (or using a springer mount), get on your mount and fly (hop) approximately half way up the length of the crystal statue.
Skywatch Lookout is a point of interest in Wizard's Ascent. It is a floating platform.
The Burning Fortress is a point of interest of the Skyward Marches fractal. It is the fortress where Balthazar rules these lands with his army of Forged.

The Hidden Falls is a communing style hero challenge in Bonerattler Caverns.

== Dialogue ==
Before completion
 This cool, quiet place has an otherworldly feel to it. Subtle traces of magical energy converge in the shadows behind the falls. Many people have come here seeking serenity.
 Commune with this place of power.
 Leave this place.
After completion
 This cool, quiet place has an otherworldly feel to it. Subtle traces of magical energy converge in the shadows behind the falls. Many people have come here seeking serenity.
 You've gained all you can from this place of power.
The Astral Ward Dining Hall is a point of interest within the Wizard's Ascent. It is a place where several tables are found and where the Astral Ward meets to eat.
The Monument to the Order it is a point of interest within the Wizard's Ascent. It is a statue in which there are members of the Astral Ward paying homage.
The Fractured Tower is a point of interest within Devastated Garenhoff. The tower is part of the city and was fragmented and suspended in the air by the magic of ley line
The Sailor's Lament is a point of interest within Devastated Garenhoff. It is a ship that is stranded on the coast.
The Spire's Heart is a point of interest within the world needle. It houses a huge Shadowstone, created by Isgarren to help protect the world of Tyria from threats in the Mists.

Harmony Green is a point of interest within Bastion of Balance.

== Notes ==
Harmony Green is the one Point of Interest of Amnytas that does not have a lantern in the Illuminating Amnytas achievement.
Spellcrafting Workshop is a point of interest in the Bastion of Strength where Galrath the Undying oversees the preparation of spells for The Defense of Amnytas and to fight against the Kryptis.

Museum of Curiosities: Main Gallery is a point of interest in the Bastion of Knowledge area of Amnytas. Combined with Museum of Curiosities: Hall of Giants it forms a museum that displays a number of statues with explanatory plaques. For more info on these, please refer to Bastion of Knowledge.

== Getting there ==
Use the Bastion of the Celestial Waypoint and glide or fly to the North East. 
To activate the point of interest, navigate ground level to the West of the tower.
Natatorium Obscurus is a large pool on top of the Bastion of the Obscure. Several of the Astral Ward fish in it.

liPOIs.strName: Museum of Curiosities: Hall of Giants
liPOIs.strWikiText: Museum of Curiosities: Hall of Giants is a point of interest in the Bastion of Knowledge area of Amnytas. Combined with Museum of Curiosities: Main Gallery it forms a museum that displays a number of statues with explanatory plaques. For more info on these, please refer to Bastion of Knowledge.
Equilibrium Glade is a clearing south of the main Bastion of Balance buildings.
The Botanical Skygarden is Narcisse's garden in the Bastion of the Natural. It houses a variety of plant life from across Tyria, both sentient and not.

The Erudition Arcade is a point of interest located in the lower section of Bastion of Knowledge, northwest of the  Bastion of Knowledge Waypoint — .

== Getting There ==
This Point of Interest is normally locked behind blue forcefields.
Option 1: 
Position your character at the edge of the forcefield blocking the northern door (see image).
Option 2: 
Wait for the Navigate Isgarren's wards event to open the barriers.
Option 3:
Using a teleport or shadowstep skill into the room might grant you the POI before teleporting you out.
The Vass Memorial Medical Plaza is a large plaza in the Bastion of Balance. Presumably this was named for the Wizard Vass after her passing.
The Grand Library of Amnytas is a library in Bastion of Knowledge.

The Great Debate Hall is a building located in the Bastion of Balance floating island.

== Notes ==
You just have to walk up the door of the Great Hall to unlock this point of interest.
It was previously only accessible during the event Escort Lyhr to the Great Hall so he can rebalance himself.
Lyhr's Tower sits atop the Bastion of Balance's Great Debate Hall. As the leader of the Basion of Balance, Lyhr's Tower forms a central part of the Bastion's architecture.
The Riftworks is a large hall in the Bastion of the Obscure where the Astral Ward like Researcher Lezzi study rifts.
The Contretemps are a series of magically dark passageways within the Bastion of the Obscure. Strange things lurk inside.
The Bastionmere is a lagoon located within the Bastion of the Natural.

The Overmere Meditation Circle is a point of interest within the Bastion of the Natural. Some characters can be found inside meditating, even the player character can enter and join in the meditation.

== Related achievements ==
 Amnytas: Absolute Focus — Join the Astral Ward members in a meditation session at the Overmere Meditation Circle. (1)
Thaumaturgy Park is a small clearing in the woods on the southeast side of the Bastion of Balance island.

Cartography Chamber is a point of interest within the Bastion of the Obscure, housing many maps and scrolls.

== Trivia ==
The maps on the walls are of the southern part of Drizzlewood Coast, the Silverwastes, Jahai Bluffs (with pins on the Pact Vanguard and Battleground Ramparts), and a ley-line map.
The Infirmary is where members of the Astral Ward are recovering.

Cellar of Arcana, also called the Hall of Secrets, is a point of interest within Bastion of Knowledge. It contains many extremely powerful artifacts collected by Isgarren over the years as leader of the Astral Ward. Normally, no one is able to access it except for Isgarren due to the maze of wards surrounding it. 

== Getting there ==
This area can be accessed through a portal  west from the Erudition Arcade, only available after completing   Navigate Isgarren's wards (80). After a while the portal will disappear and everyone inside will be kicked out.
Once   Navigate Isgarren's wards (80) is successful, the Gates on both entrances open.
From the square west of  Bastion of Knowledge Waypoint —  there is an entrance to the south-east and from the ground floor just north-west of the Point of

The Dubious Islet is a small floating island between the Bastion of Balance and the Bastion of the Obscure, home to a small group of sky-chak. The entrance to Lyhr's underground base camp under the Bastion of Balance is easily accessible from this islet.

The Circle of Rituals is the name of a point of interest in Amnytas. The Circle can be found at the cliffs in the northwest of the Bastion of Strength and is used by Vanak Faithwalker to work on spells.
Akeem's Tower is a point of interest within the Bastion of the Obscure. It's named after Akeem of the Wizard's Court, the previous leader of the Bastion.
Concocter's Lab
The Relic Repository is a large shipping dock on the north side of the Bastion of the Obscure, where the Bastion receives artifacts from the Bastion of Knowledge and other sources.

Creature Corral is a point of interest located in the Bastion of the Natural, inhabited by Forro and his companion Coconut as care-takers for several animals that occasionally tend to break loose from their pens.

== See also ==
  Help Forro purge corruption from the animals and return them home (80)
The Seething Embrace is a cliffside occupied by Kryptis in Heitor's Dominion.
The Mere of Everlasting Night is a pond in Memory's Hollow
The Tree of Mourning is the namesake of Mourning's Shade, it is a towering tree overshadowing the rest of the region.
The Rot is a point of interest in The Bleeding Wastes Located east of the WP into a cavernous area
The Tree of Many Faces is a tree engraved with stone faces in Memory's Hollow. The Inner Nayos Insight: Memory's Hollow is located on top of one of the stone faces.
The Heitor's Maw is a large gateway occupied by Kryptis in Heitor's Dominion

The The Wailing Chasm is a point of interest in Heitor's Dominion. It can be accessed either through finishing The Road to Heitor meta or gliding into the crevice. 
There is a destroyed cave entrance at the end of the natural bridge from Heitor's Gate leading into the The Commons.

Heitor's Gate is the thirteenth chapter of the Secrets of the Obscure story.

== Objectives ==
Accompany Peitha and her allies to take down Heitor in her stronghold.
Meet Peitha near Heitor's stronghold.
Attend the briefing with your allies.
Kryptis Patrols Cleared outside the Stronghold
Kryptis Trebuchet destroyed: x/3
Investigate inside the stronghold.
Locate the source of the scream.
Heitor
The Sullen Cliffside is a cliff in Heitor's Dominion. There is a stone face engraved into the cliff, similar to the one seen in Tree of Many Faces
The Hollow of the Covetous is a clearing occupied by Kryptis in Heitor's Dominion

The Pillars of Mosyn is a gateway leading to the Astral Ward Camp in Memory's Hollow

== Trivia ==
Named after Lady Mosyn.
The Astral Ward Camp is an Astral Ward staging ground nested in Memory's Hollow. Astral Ward survivors from initial Kryptis incursions in Tyria have gathered around here.
The Lost Altar is a point of interest in The Forgotten Path. It's closed off by a ward until the completion of Escort the recon team as they investigate unusual Kryptis activity.
The Ascending Dream is a staircase in Mourning's Shade leading into the rest of the region.
The Divide is a large path occupied by in Heitor's Dominion
The Southern Extractor is one of two extractors in The Bleeding Wastes
The Northern Extractor is one of two extractors in The Bleeding Wastes
The Sky King's Aerie is a plateau nestled with Tufted Skywing in Mourning's Shade
The Waters of Regret is a large pond in Heitor's Dominion

The The Pool of Whispers is a small pond with waterfalls in Mourning's Shade
There is a set of Diving Goggles to the west and far above in the tree branches, which provide an achievement and a mastery point.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest is only accessible during and after the Into the Spider's Lair event.

The Temple of Charybda is named after Charybda the Cunning, although only the Apprentice Scyllan can be found within it during the corresponding events. 

== Getting there ==
This Point of Interest can be unlocked when triggering the event   Disrupt Apprentice Scyllan's ritual (80) for a brief moment before a barrier keeps players outside. If the barrier is up then this event must be completed to clear it.

Mosyn's Repose is a point of interest in The Commons

== Trivia ==
Named after Lady Mosyn.

The River Hideaway is a small camp along the river in The Old Settlement, currently home to Researcher Lanni, some sentient Kryptis, and a Tufted Skywing. 

== Notes ==
One of the Kryptis nearby seems to be fishing in the river.

The Fortress of the Founding is Point of Interest that can be only accessible during   Wreak havoc in the Fortress of the Founding (80) event after speaking with Transformation Specialist Gustavo and during  [Group Event] Help Emund assault the Fortress of the Founding (80) stage of the The Fangs That Gnash Meta Event.

Eventide's March is the sixteenth chapter of the Secrets of the Obscure story.

== Objectives ==
Assault Eventide's March and confront Queen Labris.
Meet General Nephus north of the Temple of Charybda.
Clear the perimeter.
Enemy Strength 
Eliminate any hidden forces along the way to Eventide's March.
Enemy Strength 
Continue toward Eventide's March.
Defeat the loyalists battling in the treetops.
The Gathering Grounds is an area where Eparch loyalists keep other Kryptis enslaved.

Coliseum of the Midnight King is a point of interest within Nyedra, Dreamer's Sanctum.

== Ambient Dialogue ==
By a small house-like structure by a stream that is North-East of the POI
Loyalist Alkaios : "What have you heard of Eparch's beast?  Did it survive?"
Loyalist Daepha : "Nourys lives, yes, but for how long, who can say.  It howls out in the fog, thrashing its limbs about."
Loyalist Daepha : "I doubt we'll see it on the front lines again."
Loyalist Alkaios : "They'll regret wounding our king's prized pet.  Just wait until he gets his claws on them."
On the cliff-side, nearby the Starlight Lantern that is South-East of the POI
Avra : "Melia has joined this rebellion?"
Kostas : "Always she lets emotion color her decisions."
The Grove of the First Kryptis is a point of interest within the Commons of Inner Nayos. The name suggests that the first Kryptis once lived, or possibly, were created here.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest is only accessible during and after the Into the Spider's Lair event.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest is only accessible during and after the Into the Spider's Lair event.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest is only accessible during and after the Into the Spider's Lair event.

== Getting there ==
You can reach the Point of Interest when doing the story chapter The Eleventh Hour. It is in the sealed chamber after you defeat the Master of Reliquaries.

The Midnight Throne is the throne of King Eparch and the seat of government from which he rules all Nayos.

== Getting there ==
You can reach the Point of Interest through completing The Eleventh Hour. It is in the Final Room at the top of the stairs.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest is only accessible during and after the Into the Spider's Lair event.

This point of interest is only accessible during and after the Into the Spider's Lair event.

This point of interest is only accessible during and after the Into the Spider's Lair event.

The Pale Tree's Circle is a point of interest in the Upper Commons. This commom place is used by the sylvari as a meeting point.
The Warden's Watchgate is a point of interest in the Marshaling Field. This arched gateway crosses the path from the heart of The Grove to the outer parts of Tyria.

The Envoy's Shelter is a point of interest in the The Quester's Terrace where a few sylvari are currently practicing their combat.

== Notes ==
Profession trainers were once found here, before being removed during June 2015.
The PR-1000 Prototype Golem is an asura creation located in the College of Dynamics.
The Magihedron is a point of interest within the College of Statics. Plenty of Statics students and experts can be found in this area.

The Thamaturgic Calculus is a large device located inside the College of Synergetics.
Similar to the timekeeping devices in other capital cities (such as the Phoenix Roost in Lion's Arch), this device plays a short melody every two hours at sunrise and sunset.
The Traveler's Loft is a portion within the Great Lodge where travelers stay while in Hoelbrak.

Knut Whitebear's Loft resides on the highest level of the Great Lodge of Hoelbrak. It contains a giant chair and is blocked off from the Hunter's Hearth by two giant doors.
The entrance to Knut Whitebear's Loft is on the lowest level of the Great Lodge, at the end opposite the entrance. There are two Wolfborn on either side of the door. The entrance is not marked by the usual green star used for story and home instances, but it marked on the map as Stairs Up.

The Matriarch's Perch is a point of interest in the Canopy over Pact Encampment, a piece of an airship debree suspended by giant vines. It is the location of Kill the wyvern matriarch event during Night and the Enemy meta event in Verdant Brink.

The Last Leap is a large lump of earth located in the Canopy over Jaka Itzel. Two corrupted Champion hylek, Cotoni and Huetzi, can be found here during the event "Kill Cotoni and Huetzi".

== Getting there ==
At night, take a Pact Chopper from Wyvern Cliffs or the Pact Chopper from Jaka Itzel to the Canopy over Jaka Itzel.
With Advanced Gliding unlocked, this can also be reached from Precarious Perch.
At other times, this area can be accessed from Dust Dancer Plateau, moving to the start of the jumping puzzle then using a Raptor, Griffon, updrafts, or gliding to reach the plateau above Brooding Gulch and the Nuhoch Wallows.

The Ascendant's Ring is a piece of land that was raised into the sky by Mordremoth's vines. It has a circular platform made of the same material as Tarir and The Sealed Cavern's structures with eight small pillars in a circular pattern around the ring.

== Getting there ==
During the night
Head East from  Mellaggan's Valor Waypoint — , and take the Pact Chopper up to the Canopy over Ordnance Corps, then jump on the Bouncing Mushroom to reach it.
During day
Head for the vista to the north (the one adjacent to the word "Canopy" in "Canopy Over Ordnance Corps" on the map. Glide from the vista south onto the crashed airship, and walk along the crashed structure to reach the bouncing mushroom just to the north of the POI.

The Precarious Perch is a point of interest, a ruin piece suspended in the Canopy over Pale Reaver Rally by giant vines. It is the location of Kill the Wyvern Patriarch event during Night and the Enemy meta event in Verdant Brink.

== Getting there ==

=== During the night ===
The platform can only be accessed during the event Kill the Wyvern Patriarch, as part of the Night and the Enemy map meta event. Players have to use any Pact Chopper in any camp of the Outpost: Pale Reaver Rally. This will teleport them to a ledge just below the platform, from where they can use an airdraft with gliding and Updraft Use to reach the platform.
Alternatively, use mounts.

=== During the day ===
While the platform cannot be reached during the day without the use of mounts, the point of interest can be un

The Silent Woods is the lair of Champion Axemaster Gwyllion, a powerful Mordrem Guard, and his pack of smokescales.

== Getting there ==
From Matriarch's Perch fly westwards to the big updraft, then orient to the Silent Woods and use the smaller updrafts beside it to get the last few meters up before landing.

The Colosseum of the Faithful is a large White Mantle ruin nestled in the skies of the Bloodstone Fen. Many spirits that were sacrificed to the Bloodstone long ago roams there freely, attacking anything on sight.
The Tomb of the Confessors is a point of interest in the Haunted Canyons. This White Mantle ruin is the resting place of many of their confessors. A small Pact camp is set up right at the entrance.
The Salvation Springs are a point of interest located in the Haunted Canyons. Despite the chaos of the Bloodstone Fen, this quiet waterfall continues to prosper.
The Bloodstone's Shell is what remains of the Maguuma Bloodstone after its devastating explosion.

The Eternal Pool is a point of interest in the Savage Rise. This shallow underground pool ringed with ancient, broken stone pillars is guarded by angered nature spirits.

== Getting there ==
Starting from Scout's Clearing, follow the cliff wall South-East. The wall will turn South and then West as it leads down into a cave. This point of interest is at the end of the cave.

== Related achievements ==
 Flashpoint: Nature's Wrath — Slay the champion greater wardbough near Savage Rise. (3)

The Druid's Grotto is a point of interest in the Savage Rise. It is kept lush and verdant by the druids who protect Draconis Mons.

== Notes ==
The grotto is located underground, and can be accessed from an opening hidden in a rock shelter on a ledge jutting out from the Savage Rise, northwest of the point of interest.
To access it from  Heathen's Hold Waypoint —  on the floor above, head west to the very edge then fall or glide directly down through the steam onto the ledge that juts out from the Savage Rise. Get to the layer tucked underneath, with a giant fern peeking out from the very edge, and some grubs within the rock shelter. Head inwards southeast past a Speed Boost Mushroom until you find the cave opening.

The Golem Graveyard is a point of interest in the Ancient Hollow. Remains from golems that were left to fend for themselves on Draconis Mons when their creators, the Asura from Rata Arcanum, including Zinn, died can be found here.
The Peace Grounds are a point of interest in the Savage Rise. This small secluded pond serves as the home of Liriodendron, one of the druid guardians of Draconis Mons.
Viraddi's Salvation is a point of interest in the Savage Rise area of Draconis Mons. This small crevice is used by Scientist Viraddi as a place to hide from the dangerous creatures roaming the area.
The Scout's Clearing is a point of interest in the Savage Rise. Vigil forces are attempting to rescue members of their scouting party from the dangers of Draconis Mons.
Nu Vault is a point of interest in the Ancient Hollow. It is one of four vaults in and around Draconis Mons built years ago by Asura who fled Rata Novus.
Jofast's Camp is a Pact camp used to strike the Risen found at the Cathedral of Verdance.

The Shrine of the Six is located in The Upper City and lies opposite of the Seraph Headquarters. It contains statues and banners of all Six Human Gods. The highest ranked priest or priestess for each god in Divinity's Reach spend their time here.

== Notes ==
The design of the banner of Kormir sticks out from the others, next to the portrait of the goddess it shows the heraldic symbols four Red Iris Flowers.

The Seraph Headquarters is the main base of operations for the Seraph in Divinity's Reach and is a part of the Royal Palace. It acts as Captain Logan Thackeray's office, though he is rarely in there. Lieutenant Groban appears to run the office in Logan's stead. The Seraph Headquarters contains a roster of all active Seraph members. Its basement contains a five cell prison.

== Related achievements ==
 Coalescence II: The Gift: Bottle of Shame (Empty)

The Queen's Throne Room is a section of the Royal Palace, accessed from the Upper City of Divinity's Reach. It is where Queen Jennah spends her time, speaking with emissaries from other nations as well as Krytan ministers.

== Notes ==
* Various NPCs enter the Throne Room to address Queen Jennah, or simply pass through. There may be others as well.

The Chamber of Ministers is where the Krytan Ministry convene in order to make and review legislation for the Kingdom of Kryta. The building was designed to be purposefully open, in order to reflect the Ministry's role as speakers for the people.
The Chamber is protected by the Ministry Guard, who prevent citizens from disturbing proceedings. The punishment for this used to be flogging, but this was later outlawed by Minister Caudecus. Although not allowed to interrupt assemblies, citizens may by right still approach Ministers before or after them.

== Notes ==
To earn the Ponder the World item for Astralaria I: The Device, stand on the world globe and type /ponder.

The Central Plaza is the large garden and orrery found in the direct center of Divinity's Reach, within The Upper City. The garden was designed by the Grand Wizard Garren and built under order of King Roderick around 1265 AE. It depicts various stylized astronomical bodies, including the Sun and the Moon.

== Related achievements ==
 Astralaria III: The Mechanism: Divinity's Reach's Garden Rings — Ponder the rings in the central garden in Divinity's Reach.

liPOIs.strWikiText: The Soul of the Pale Tree is a point of interest in the Omphalos Chamber. This is where the Avatar of the Tree can be found, where the Pale Tree communicates directly with sylvari and other races' dignitaries, though it is possible for her to talk to them from anywhere in The Grove.

Ventari's Tablet was inscribed by the centaur Ventari. It holds seven tenets that speak of the peaceful centaur's morals and ethics. The Pale Tree used the Ventari Tablet for the sylvari's ethics and morals, leading the Firstborn to embrace it like the words of a prophet. It is their most sacred artifact, and is a constant topic of debate among the sylvari as they discuss the tenets' meanings.

== Teachings ==
Ventari's teachings, without the dialog options, are as follows:
  Live life well and fully, and waste nothing.
  Do not fear difficulty. Hard ground makes stronger roots.
  The only lasting peace is the peace within your own soul.
  All things have a right to grow. The blossom is brother to the weed.
  Never leave a wrong to ripen into evil or sorrow.
  Act with wisdom, but act.
  F

The Arcane Council (Asuran:  ) is the main governing body for the asura. They reside within the Council Level of Rata Sum where they hold their meetings, and are currently lead by High Councillor Flax. Members that are inducted into the council include prestigious inventors, well-known diplomats, and the deans of each of the three asuran colleges. They regulate the laws and racial projects of the asura, though their influence doesn't stretch much further than Soren Draa.
Induction into the Arcane Council is generally avoided by potential candidates―personal preference is given to working on their own inventions, than to assist in bureaucratic matters. This can sometimes lead to potential candidates tricking others into joining the Arcane Council in their place, as well as member of the Arc
The Temple of Sacrifice is ruin nestled high in the skies of the Bloodstone Fen.

Asura Gate can refer to one of these:
Asura gate, an overview of the method of transportation.
Ancient Gate, the gate found in Eye of the North, used to teleport to various places including Strike Missions and Dragon Response Missions.
Asura Gate (Rata Arcanum), the point of interest in Draconis Mons.
Asura Gate (Royal Terrace), the gate found in the Royal Terrace lounge.
Asura Gate (Salvation Pass), the object found in Salvation Pass.
Asura Gate (Sorrow's Gate), the dungeon object.
Asura Gate (Winter Wonderland), the portal at the end of the Winter Wonderland
The Sandstone Archway is a point of interest in the Scalding Gorge. This natural rock formation towers above everything else in the gorge.
The Prisoner's Perch is a point of interest in the Heathen's Hold. It is a holding area for prisoners at the Mercenary Encampment.

The Wurm's Furnace is a point of interest in the Heathen's Hold. This lava pool is inhabited by a wurm that has been captured and forcefully empowered via the feeding of Bloodstone shards by Balthazar's Mercenaries.
The Mercenary Encampment is a point of interest in the Heathen's Hold. It is a camp established by Balthazar's Mercenaries to guard access to the Gate of Fire.

Searing Ascent is a jumping puzzle in Draconis Mons, starting at the Searing Ascent point of interest. At the end of the jumping puzzle is an Ancient Chest which can be opened every 12 hours[verification requested], and completing the jumping puzzle the first time awards the Searing Ascent achievement.

== Walkthrough ==

=== Tips ===
The Oakheart's Reach mastery is required to complete the jumping puzzle, as the player will need to make use of several Oakheart's Essences along the way.
Gliding is a pivotal feature of this jumping puzzle. The Lean Techniques and Advanced Gliding masteries are required for successful completion.
Prototype Position Rewinder isn't very helpful here, because using it removes all Oakheart's Reach charges.

== Related achievements ==
 Flashpoint: Searing Ascent

The Burial Chamber is a point of interest in the Golemancer's Tomb. It is the resting place of Zinn, renown asuran golemancer who founded both Rata Novus and Rata Arcanum.

== Trivia ==
The writing on Zinn's memorial stone is Ascalonian and reads "Zinn. His genius knew no bounds".
Before May 16, 2017 the word 'bounds' was misspelled as 'bovns'.

Iota Vault is a point of interest in the Heathen's Hold. It is one of four vaults in and around Draconis Mons built years ago by Asura who fled Rata Novus.

== Getting there ==
There is a Thermal Tube entrance just south of the Heathen's Hold waypoint; using this Thermal Tube will catapult you northwards, then northwest until you arrive on a bat-infested ledge high above Heathen's Hold. The door to the Iota Vault is at the far end of the ledge to the west of where you land. The door will not open unless you have completed the related story part.

Nu II Vault is a point of interest in Rata Arcanum. It is one of four vaults in and around Draconis Mons built years ago by asura who fled Rata Novus.

== Getting there ==
From Heathen's Hold Waypoint, take the Northern thermal tube to reach the volcano, and then the second thermal tube to be taken directly to the vault.
The Inquest Field Lab is a point of interest in Rata Arcanum. It a large camp that has been established by the Inquest to further study and excavate the ruined colony.
The Gate of Fire is a point of interest in Titan's Throat. It stands in the entrance to the heart of the volcano inside Draconis Mons.
The House of Aife is home of Cycle of Dawn's Luminary Aife.
The House of Kahedins is home of Cycle of Dusk's Luminary Kahedins.
The House of Riannoc was the home of firstborn Riannoc.
The House of Caithe is on the bottom floor of The Grove within the Garden of Night and is where Caithe lives. Caithe can be found blending poisons for her blades at the table.
The House of Malomedies is home of Cycle of Night's Luminary Malomedies.
The House of Niamh is home of Cycle of Noon's Luminary Niamh.
The Inquest Recruiting Station is the headquarters of the Inquest within Rata Sum.
The Peacemakers Headquarters is the local HQ of the Peacemakers inside Rata Sum. The holding cells are also located there.
The Aquatarium is a large water tank used by the apprentices of Rata Sum to study underwater creatures.
The Temple of Renewal is a White Mantle ruin found floating inside the Cavern of Unseen Lights.
The Crater's Precipice is a rocky cliff overlooking the gaping hole where the Maguuma Jungle Bloodstone once stood.

The Eastern Bastion is a segment of the outer wall near the main entrance that projects out from the fortifications. This gives archers a better vantage point to attack any intruders storming the gates.

The Servant Quarters are two outbuildings that provide lodgings and relaxation for the servants of the house. They also keep them conveniently out of the way of the more sinister goings-on. The eastern building is well-furnished, with beds, chairs, a kitchen area, and decorations. The western building appears to be all but abandoned, with papers scattered all over the floor and blankets spread on the bare floor.

== Notes ==
The western building has a balcony on the upper floor. Attempting to enter it will cause you to be teleported back across the room.
The Manor Barn is one of the outbuildings of Caudecus's Manor. Its main purpose appears to be for storage, but it is also an occasional meeting place for bandits.

The Separatist Camp is a makeshift camp used by Separatist Captain DeLana when she attempted to assassinate Queen Jennah during Minister Caudecus's party. It was afterwards used by Turmaine to interrogate Sergeant Gunther.
The Bandit Barracks are sleeping quarters for the bandits that are using Minister Caudecus's Manor and nearby areas to trade slaves to centaurs.

The Minister's Cabinet Room is a meeting room on the ground floor of Minister Caudecus's Beetlestone Manor intended for the minister's cabinet. There is a lectern by the northwestern wall flanked by Seraph Guard statues; tables and chairs are arrayed before the lectern in a semicircle. The room is lit by a fireplace on the northeastern wall, a candle chandelier and various candelabra.

The Grand Salon is the central chamber and receiving room of the mansion. From here you can access the upper floors in the east and west wings.

== Trivia ==
Among the books on the table in the northern corner are copies of From the Shadows - Inside the Order of Whispers written in Ascalonian.

The Drawing Room is intended for entertaining Minister Caudecus' guests. Several chairs and sofas are arranged near the fireplace on the southwestern wall. Arrayed around the room are several hunting trophies, including a stuffed jungle stalker.

Caudecus' Reading Room is a well-furnished library, found near the main entrance of the mansion itself. Bookshelves packed with many leather-bound books reach to the ceiling. Several plush high-back chairs and rich paintings give the room a cozy feel, marred only by the copious amount of books scattered on the floor, awaiting a home on the shelves.

== Notes ==
Despite appearing in the map during Confessor's End, this point of interest cannot be reached during said story instance. The reading room can only be accessed in the dungeon version of Caudecus's Manor.
The Main Dining Room is, as its name implies, the main dining room on the ground floor of Minister Caudecus's Beetlestone Manor.

The Master Chamber is Minister Caudecus's bedroom in Caudecus's Manor. It is located off the study in the upper level.

== Notes ==
One can find a mirror attached to the ceiling above the bed.

The Guest Chamber is a bedroom for guests in the upper level of Caudecus's Manor. Visitors can feel safe from late-night intruders thanks to the extensive (and deadly) system of traps installed in the floor.

== Notes ==
Only accessible during Seraph's Path of Caudecus's Manor explorable mode.
The Pact Encampment is the main base of operations for the Pact within the Ruined City of Arah after Zhaitan's defeat.
Melandru's Dome is the standing location protected by Vahid, High Priest of Melandru.
Demon's Shoal is the standing location guarded by the Risen Pirate Alphard, Serpent of the Waves in The Rotten Armada within The Ruined City of Arah.

The Salvage of the "Whitebear's Pride" is the wreckage of one of the Pact's airships that crashed during the assault on Zhaitan in the skies above the Ruined City of Arah. The airship is named after Knut Whitebear.

The Salvage of the "Riannoc's Dream" is the wreckage of one of the Pact's airships that crashed during the assault on Zhaitan in the skies above the Ruined City of Arah. The airship is named after Riannoc.
The Salvage of the "Lady Livia" is the wreckage of one of the Pact's airships that crashed during the assault on Zhaitan in the skies above the Ruined City of Arah. The airship is named after Livia.

The Slaughtercrypt is the main room of the Crypts of the Dreaming Dead. This location is visited in the 'Seer Path' of The Ruined City of Arah Dungeon and is home to a number of Risen, Wraiths and the Corrupted Ghasem, High Priest of Grenth.

The Wreck of the Scorchrazor is a Pact airship that crashed during the aerial battle with Zhaitan. It appears to be larger than most airships with a larger crew, whom survived the crash and became surrounded by Risen. The airship was named after Kalla Scorchrazor.
Mursaat Test Bed Zeleph is a platform within the Inquest's base where they're testing out the phasing magic of the mursaat.

The Mystic Telescope is an ancient jotun magical observatory to study the stars. According to Varra Skylark, the stars mark the passage of the ages for Tyria, though not influential themselves, and the creation of new stars coincide with the cycles of Elder Dragon risings.
The Grand Processional Gate is the main entryway into the Grand Temple of the Pantheon.

The Bloodstones' Unmaking is, as the name implies, the location where the Six Human Gods sundered the original Bloodstone. Now, there is a central altar where a large Bloodstone Shard, untouched but guarded by the Risen, resides.

== Notes ==
The altar consists of a "sandwich" of 2 rectangular stones and dozens of human skulls in between. The stones are covered in spilt blood. Both these facts together suggest that human sacrifices were conducted at the altar after the resurging of Orr.
During the fight against the Bloodstone Shard, light emits from the eye cavities of the skulls.

The Altar of Glaust is a large Forgotten altar that is required for an ancient ritual capable of giving free will to Elder Dragon minions. It was here that Glint was freed from Kralkatorrik's control when she was known as Glaust, which the altar bears the name of. When the ritual is cast, beams of light break through the unnatural clouds above and through the circular architecture surrounding the altar. Though it predates the Six Human Gods arrival on Tyria and is of Forgotten make, the altar is of the same design as the rest of Arah and most Orrian structures, which are said to be made by the Six Gods or modeled off of the gods' designs.
The Imperial Barge of Orr is a large ship seen which was docked in The Ruined City of Arah.

Pact Encampment Waypoint may refer to:
The waypoint in Stonetwist paths, in Verdant Brink.
The waypoint in Nave of Arah, inside the Ruined City of Arah dungeon.

Zhaitan's Rest is an empty point of interest within The Ruined City of Arah.

== Trivia ==
Some maps pulled from the Gw2.dat during the Beta Weekend Events featured a large dragon's corpse matching the dead dragon seen in the Guild Wars 2 Teaser Trailer, which in turn is similar to earlier concept art works of Zhaitan.
During an interview with Jeff Grubb and Ree Soesbee, it was said that Zhaitan's corpse would be visible in Arah.

The Salvage of the "Whitebear's Pride" is the wreckage of one of the Pact's airships that crashed during the assault on Zhaitan in the skies above the Ruined City of Arah. The airship is named after Knut Whitebear.
The Pact Encampment is the main base of operations for the Pact within the Ruined City of Arah after Zhaitan's defeat.

The Salvage of the "Riannoc's Dream" is the wreckage of one of the Pact's airships that crashed during the assault on Zhaitan in the skies above the Ruined City of Arah. The airship is named after Riannoc.
The Salvage of the "Lady Livia" is the wreckage of one of the Pact's airships that crashed during the assault on Zhaitan in the skies above the Ruined City of Arah. The airship is named after Livia.

The Draconic Battery is a series of three Risen Orrian Towers that function as anti-air magical turrets are situated on the Dragontooth Defense. The towers hinder the Pact airforce during the assault on Zhaitan.

Zhaitan's Last Stand marks the location of the tower which Zhaitan clung onto after its largest tails were cut off, its largest right arm fell off, and its largest right wing was crippled, grounding it. The tower fell with Zhaitan's defeat, following the Elder Dragon's own fall through the heavy clouds over Arah.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest is only visible during the last step of the personal story, Victory or Death. It is the location of the final fight with Zhaitan. This point of interest cannot be acquired except by breaking out of the map.

== Notes ==
Since this point of interest only exists within the story step Victory or Death, it does not count towards map completion.
