liPOIs.strWikiText: The Ruins of the Mirror of Lyss is a point of interest within the Grand Court of Sebelkeh. This former shrine to Lyssa has been corrupted by Kralkatorrik, although the architecture remains intact. Players will be under the effect of Fury of the Brand in the surrounding area.
The Northern Maw is a Point of Interest in The Desolation. It's one of the gates that grants entrance into the center of The Ruptured Heart, along with the Eastern Maw and Western Maw.

The Bone Palace is a point of interest in Joko's Domain and serves as Palawa Joko's seat of power. The palace was originally constructed in 757 AE, and it was said that the souls of those whose bodies were used in its making could be heard screaming for release. After Palawa Joko conquered Elona, he expanded the palace utilizing the bones of the Elonian centaurs he brought to extinction.

== Getting there ==
The Bone Palace is southwest from  Joko's Domain Waypoint — . If the event to defeat the Canid Throneguard is active or failed recently, the palace is surrounded by a wall of green light and the door is closed.
While this event is active, the staircases on the sides of the palace have to be used to enter the throne chamber on a higher level.
If the event recently failed, the interior o

Acrid Sink is a point of interest located of the bottom of the Caustic Spur canyon in The Desolation. The ground around it is covered with Sulfurous Haze and some packs of sulfurous oozes can be found in the sulfur pools nearby.

== Getting there ==
The closest waypoint is  The Darklands Waypoint — . Traveling a short distance directly west from this waypoint leads to the southern end of the Caustic Spur, which lies high above the Acrid Sink. Gliding or flying north down through the canyon leads right to this point of interest.

Junundu Lookout is a point of interest located within the Alkali Pan in the Desolation.

== Getting there ==
The point of interest is on top of the lookout tower. Using the stairs to get to the top can be difficult due to traps knocking the player off the winding stair-case and some foes following the player upstairs. It is also possible to get directly to the top by gliding or using the Griffon mount from high locations either north or west (e.g. eastern tip of Djinn Enclave) of the tower.

Matriarch's View is a point of interest in the Boundary Preserve, in the northeastern corner of The Desolation. It is located on a ledge high above the vale and it is guarded by a large group of Harpies.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest can be easily reached with a Springer from the lower parts of the area.
The Imperial Sulfurworks is a Point of Interest in The Desolation which marks a concentration in the sulfur mining hardware in the quarry.
Forged Firebase is a major Forged fortress situated in The Shattered Ravines which is in constant siege warfare with Fort Huduh.

Springer's Ladder is a point of interest in Poisoned Outcrops marking the blocky, stair-like rock layers which form a natural barrier between the Boundary Preserve and the Poisoned Outcrops.

== Getting there ==
Using a Springer, jump up from the southwest corner of the Boundary Preserve. Or, using a Jackal, use the series of portals which start at the north end of the Shadow Arcade.

The Zayan Gate is a Point of Interest at the entrance to a cave where the main street through the Desolation passes from the Shattered Ravines into the Scourgeway.

== Notes ==
The fortress that once guarded this passage seems to have been ripped apart by Abaddon's corrupted tentacles during Nightfall.
The petrified remains of the tentacles can still be seen.

== Trivia ==
Zayan Gate might be named after Zayan the Twisted.

The Bleached Pillars is a several rock pillars connected with wooden bridges and Sand Portals found in the north western portion of Broken Shelf. Devourers and Earth Elementals roam nearby.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest is in the center of the wide, open Broken Shelf and can be reached easily. The closest waypoint is the  Sand Jackal Run Waypoint — .

== Notes ==
The mount race, which starts in the nearby Sand Jackal Run, leads right over the Bleached Pillars.

Uhiwi's Bones is a point of interest in the eastern part of The Desolation. The  Desolation Insight: Shattered Ravines can be found in a small corner south of it.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest can be reached by traveling southeast from the  Lair of the Forgotten Waypoint —  and then crossing a short basalt canyon at the very eastern edge of the map.

== Notes ==
There is a pile of bones on the wall that, if interacted with, will spawn the hostile ghost of a giant.

Chukeht Overlook is a point of interest located in The Scourgeway. This small Awakened camp on a high cliff looks out over the sulfurous chasms beneath the small rocky crags where various scruffy animals such as Hyenas make their home. 

== Notes ==
There is a spire located nearby with an Abandoned Griffon Egg, which is part of the Open Skies achievement.

The Vermitheater is a point of interest located within The Alkali Pan in The Desolation. It is a small sulfur island shaped like a natural arena. The legendary Junundu wurm Queen Ishraa spawns in the center of the theater during a bounty hunt event.

== Getting there ==
The Vermitheater is right west of the  Sand Jackal Run Waypoint — .

Conquest Overlook is a point of interest in The Desolation. This tower provides a good vantage point to help the Forged defend The Mouth of Torment from the Order of Whispers and other threats to their source of new soldiers.
Towering Links is a point of interest found in The Scourgeway.
Torment's Watch is a point of interest in The Ruination. The Order of Shadows use it to guard the southern tunnel entrance to the Chantry of Shadows from attacks by the Forged.

The Clanmarshal's Pergola is a point of interest within the Palawa Cut area in the Desolation.

== Getting there ==
Follow the road south-west from  Bonestrand Waypoint — , going east up the hill near the Palawa Cut marking on the map. Enter the building guarded by some Awakened, and head into the hall.

The Forbidden Vault is a secret chamber in which Palawa Joko keeps his harem of women, men, ogres, harpies, and choya. Some of the concubines are volunteers, but many were offered as a sacrifice by their villages to secure protection. Joko enjoys spending "quality time" here.

== Getting there ==
The chamber is only accessible after completion of Help Buuran investigate the mysterious gate; however, the point of interest may be uncovered by simply running up to the closed gate.

== Related achievements ==
 The Desolation: Joko's Hidden Chamber — Gain entry to Joko's hidden chamber. (2)
 The Desolation: A Family's Sacrifice — Tell Tiba about her father's death, and locate her sister. (3)
Speak to Betrothed Villager behind the central statue within the vault (only after interacting with the

An ancient tree sits atop Lone-Tree Hill in The Desolation. Many skulls litter the base of the tree and ravens roost in its branches.

== Getting there ==
With Springer's High Vault unlocked
From  Joko's Domain Waypoint — , use your Springer to jump up the cliff behind the waypoint. Head west, switching to your Raptor, Griffon, or glider to leap or fly across the ravine. Swap back to your Springer to jump up the cliffs and head towards the tree.

Fort Huduh is a major Awakened fortress situated in The Shattered Ravines which is in constant siege warfare with Forged Firebase.

== Notes ==
It is often surrounded by a force field, preventing entry, but the point of interest can still be unlocked from the west side, on the rafters.
It may have been named in reference to General Huduh from Guild Wars.

The Vabbian Corridor is a point of interest in the southeastern part of The Desolation. The large gate is used by Balthazar's Forged to travel towards The Foundry in the Domain of Vabbi.

== Notes ==
This passage is inaccessible to the player.

The Mouth of Torment is a twisted crater on the former shoreline of the Crystal Sea. When Abaddon rebelled against the other five gods, it was here that the final blow was dealt and Abaddon's defeat made certain. Once a beautiful land, it has been twisted by the energies of Abaddon seeping in from the Realm of Torment, slowly spreading the toxicity of the sulfurous wasteland that makes up The Desolation.
For a millennium, an orb of tormented energies floated above the land where Abaddon's former armor and sword were nestled in the crater's walls. But in 1075 AE, Warmarshal Varesh Ossa performed a ritual to enhance Abaddon's reach into Tyria, calling the old remnants of Abaddon into the Realm of Torment itself. Though Varesh was killed in the attempt, the ritual was a success, tearing open

Ember Heights is a Point of Interest in The Desolation marking some tall stone pillars which are home to many Embers and Fire Imps.

== Notes ==
A statue of Dwayna, required for the Path of the Gods achievement can be found south-southwest of this point of interest.
Wayward Watch is a point of interest in the Lair of the Forgotten. Here, three human ghosts, Chessa, Kane, and Larano stand watch and contemplate the current state of Elona.
Scourge's Threshold is a Point of Interest in The Desolation. This area marks the beginning of the Scourgeway and other hostile environments.

Lupicus Boneyard is a graveyard of huge beasts, their tar-covered fossils. The passageway towards the Domain of Vabbi can be found directly east of this point of interest.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest can be reached by traveling east from  Joko's Domain Waypoint —  through a short cave filled with Cave Spiders and Spiderwebs and otherwise following the road visible on the compass.

The Shadow Arcade is a Point of Interest in The Desolation marked by a set of 3 archways, leading to a Jackal portal. Shadow Imps appear along the ledges when something approaches the Lost Chest in the middle. 

== Notes ==
In architecture, an arcade is a series of arches alongside or supporting a wall.

The Eastern Maw is a Point of Interest in The Desolation, and one of the main three points of attack during Maws of Torment.  It's one of the gates that grants entrance into the center of The Ruptured Heart, along with the Northern Maw and Western Maw.

The Toxic Pools is a point of interest in the Helcoid Seeps area, at the eastern edge of The Desolation. The sulfur pools nearby are notable for their blue coloring, visibly different from the yellow sulfur streams in the other parts of the zone. Many Sulfurous Oozes can be found within the pools, with Wind Riders floating around them.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest is located within a wide, open area, and can be easily reached from anywhere nearby. The closest waypoint is the  Lair of the Forgotten Waypoint —  in the south.

The Sandfall Sanctum is a point of interest in The Desolation.

== Getting there ==
Follow the road south-west from  Bonestrand Waypoint — , going east up the hill near the Palawa Cut marking on the map. Go past Clanmarshal's Pergola and south-east to the point of interest.
To pass the sand wall inside, you can to use a jackal that is trained in the Shifting Sands mastery to be able to jump through the two Sand Portals. Alternatively, you can jump with a springer up the rocks to the east side of the sand wall, dismount and run through a gap to either glide or remount your springer to negate fall damage  and drop down to the mastery insight.
The Bonestrand Garrison is a Point of Interest in The Desolation. The garrison is stationed full of Awakened forces.

The Chantry of Shadows is the Order of Shadows' base of operations in Elona. Some parts of the base are sealed behind doors, safe from any unwanted visitors.

== Notes ==
Despite being separate organizations, the Chantry of Shadows is embellished with Sunspear insignias.

The Junundu Hatchery is a point of interest in the Basaltic Fringe. Junundu Wurms use this place to breed and hatch their eggs.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest can be reached by going straight south from  Joko's Domain Waypoint —  and passing The Bone Palace.
The Western Maw is a Point of Interest near the center of the Ruptured Heart in The Desolation, and one of the main three points of attack during Maws of Torment.

Blind Faith is a point of interest within Silent Vale in The Desolation. At least several dozen from the Village of Purity are said to secretly worship Kormir here.

== Notes ==
A statue of Kormir, required for the Path of the Gods achievement can be found near this point of interest, in Silent Vale.

The Village of Purity is a point of interest in The Desolation. This village has been under the rule of Palawa Joko for a long time, but lately there's been hardship as the vizier has been cracking down. Many of the younger generation in the town have been trying to leave Joko's empire by escaping north of The Bone Wall, and there's furtive whispers of rebellion as food runs low and the war encroaches on their homes.
The Revealer Vantage is a Point of Interest on a tower in The Desolation.

The Bitumen Reserve is an underground area behind The Bone Palace of Palawa Joko. It serves as a Point of Interest in The Desolation.

== Getting there ==
It cannot be reached by going straight through the Palace; instead, one has to go there by circumventing the throne room either on the right or left side. You will find a cave entrance at the foot of the cliff wall with a set of white stairs (SW of the POI) leading you down into an underground area filled with various enemies. After descending the stairs you will reach a dark, short tunnel. At the end you will be greeted by a statue made out of the bones of two now extinct Elonian centaurs. The room at the end of the tunnel is decorated with skulls and other various bones, just like The Bone Palace.
The Henge of Joko is a mesa top full of Shades and Fleshreavers.

The Bonecage Paddock is a Point of Interest in The Desolation. It contains an Awakened Abomination, either a Veteran Awakened Abomination, or when the bounty is active, Legendary Awakened Hoarder.

== Getting there ==
Follow the path found on the south side of the Bonestrand Garrison up into the lower level of the cliffs.

== Notes ==
The Forged in the area will rarely wander too close to the paddock, causing the Veteran Awakened Abomination to attack. Area effects from both sides will rarely affect nearby spiders and wandering elementals, turning the area into a war zone.

The Tarstone Weeps is a Point of Interest in a hidden tar pit in the southeast of The Desolation. The  Desolation Insight: Tarstone Weeps is right next to it.

== Getting there ==
Starting from  Joko's Domain Waypoint — , follow the road East heading towards the portal to the Domain of Vabbi. Once you see the portal, you should be able to see on your left a cave in the upper area of the stones. Use your Springer mount to jump into the opening. Once up in the cave, just go in deeper to reach what seems to be a lair of Tar Elementals.

The Sandstrewn Shrine is a point of interest located in The Darklands. Helpful Sunspear Ghosts wander around the sunken ruins of the buildings which once surrounded the shrine, giving hints to those who wish to summon and speak with First Spear Dehvad. 

== Notes ==
Can find the Virzak, the Rune of Compassion for the Open Skies: The Desolation Achievement

Djinn Enclave is a point of interest located in Sand Jackal Run in The Desolation marking a large settlement of djinn who are cleansing Abbadon's magic of torment and re-purposing the magic in the form of a Jackal.
Fallback Fissure is a cave located in Champion's Gap in the Elon Riverlands.

The Sepulcher is the inner area within The Deadhouse prison in Elon Riverlands. The prison is guarded by the Awakened.

== Getting there ==
Follow the road south from Palawa's Grace. Veer towards The Triumph of Palawa Joko and continue on. Access may be restricted by nearby events.

== Notes ==
Stoneyard Rest is an area with fallen statues located in Elon Flow. There is also a defector camp nearby waiting to help guide Defectors.

Decimation Bend is a point of interest in the Ustulate Barrens, which is located in the northeast corner of the Elon Riverlands.

== Trivia ==
A teleporter can be activated and used near the Point of Interest.
Syrtic Impasse is a point of interest surrounded by quicksand in Deadlock Sweep, Elon Riverlands.
Elon Falls is a large waterfall in the eastern part of Elon Flow.

Heroes' Overlook is a haunted outpost located in the Skyward Reach. This place was once used as the gateway to Augury Rock and the Hall of Ascension. It now lies abandoned, only inhabited by magical creatures and ghosts of people who failed to ascend.

== Notes ==
A nearby Crystal Desert Mastery Insight is located on top of a mesa and it's reachable only with Springer (with the High Vault mastery).
The Vista located at the western side of the location shows a cinematic of the location.
Giant's Rise is a Point of Interest within Prophet's Path area.

First Camp is a point of interest in Skyward Reach. This is the first camp of the Followers of Ascension, a group of people looking to ascend at Augury Rock like the heroes of old. The group consists of humans, but also sylvari, norn, asura and surprisingly some charr.
The Second Camp is a point of interest in the Skyward Reach. It is a Followers of Ascension camp located near Branded lands.
Dragoon Hearth is a large cave area within the Whispering Grottos.

Godslost Sandfalls is a lake of quicksand found in the Skyward Reach. Beneath the lake lies the Cave of the Lost, which is full of statues of the Six Gods, and likely the origin of Godslost Sandfalls' name.
Pillars of Supremacy is a tall mesa occupied by the Forged in the Skimshallow Cove.

Leviathan's Gullet is a small underground cave in The Quickmire, entered through a leviathan skeleton. The cave is occupied and guarded by the Awakened.

== Notes ==
If you have a Skimmer, you can use it to cross the quicksand to the Mastery Insight and obtain the Point of Interest marker that way.
A teleporter can be activated and used for a quick retreat. The teleporter won't work in the other direction.
To activate the teleporter, stand on the round platform with small pillars, and wait for the teleportation sequence to begin. Then observe the sequence of the four crystals rising up and repeat it. You can then use the teleporter to get out.
Threefold Waylay is a Point of Interest in the Skyward Reach. This Forgotten ruin was Branded over when the Elder Dragon Kralkatorrik flew above it while making its way towards Vabbi.

Throne of Pellentia is a point of interest, a ruined throne built by Turai Ossa to attract the attention of the Gods. The throne was inside Palace of Ascension and those standing on the throne would be judged whether or not they were worthy of Ascension.

== Notes ==
A Place of power is on the throne.
There is a Shallows of Despair Vista on top of the ruins northeast of the Point of Interest. It can be reached with a Springer.

== Trivia ==
The Veteran Water Djinns are constantly fighting other foes in the area.

Sandwallow Retreat is a point of interest located in Champion's Gap in the Elon Riverlands. A skimmer is needed to access it.

== Getting there ==
The entrance to the cavern is to the north of Defector Harun. Access it by dropping down into the cravasse.

== Notes ==
Entering the cave beneath will apply the  Barrier Wind effect.

Palawa's Grace is the prison village where exiles from Elona are sentenced to live as they work the farms along the Elon River's gladefields. The exiles are often harassed by the Awakened, forced to give heavy taxes in food or face death and subsequent Awakening.
Bahdaj Vigil is a point of interest in the Shallows of Despair, which is located in the southwest corner of the Elon Riverlands.

The Triumph of Palawa Joko is a large statue of Palawa Joko.

== Notes ==
A vista can be found at the base of the statue.
The Joko Gate is a large bone gate separating Elon Riverlands and The Desolation. It is guarded by multiple Awakened forces.

Pilgrims' Folly is a ruin in the Elon Riverbank area of the Elon Riverlands.

== Notes ==
 Elon Riverbank Vista is at the top of the ruin.
Exile's Rest is a graveyard that is the resting area of dead exiles fleeing Palawa Joko.

Garden of the Chosen is a Point of Interest on top of a mesa in Vulture Drifts.

== Notes ==
An activatable teleporter is placed between two mesas enabling easy access to the area. The mesa is under "drifts" on the map.
To activate the teleporter, stand on the circular platform with pillars and face the four glowing crystals. Remember the sequence the crystals rise in and repeat it to activate the teleporter.
There is also a jackal portal to the landing above this Point of Interest. The portal is between the words "Vulture Drifts" on the map and Palawa's Grace Point of Interest.
The Scattered Remnants is a point of interest in the Skyward Reach.

The Hall of Ascension can be found inside the mesa at Augury Rock in Elon Riverlands. It was where the final test of Ascension, defeating a Doppelganger, happened. Previously, it could be only accessed by those who have gained the favor of the Gods by completing the Ascension trials. Now it hosts the Flameseeker Verses, and is guarded by Josso Essher.

== Getting there ==
The Path to Ascension is the meta event that takes place in Elon Riverlands and is needed to unlock access to the Hall of Ascension.
To obtain the point of interest you can use a Springer to jump up onto the ledge west of the marker. Augury Rock does not need to be open as you can simply approach the purple crystals in front of the entrance to obtain the POI.

Ossa's Defeat is a point of interest located in the very northwest of Deadlock Sweep in Elon Riverlands.

== Notes ==
 Elon Riverlands Insight: Ossa's Defeat is also located here.

Sandbound Towers is a Point of Interest located in the The Quickmire. The ruins of structures are standing in a large lake of quicksand. Human bodies are also scattered along the edges of the quicksand.
Skritt's Audience is a Point of Interest within The Scavengelands. There are several pieces of large statues in the area, with scaffolding around them.

Lonely Vigil is a giant fallen statue within the Elon Flow. It was once one of the tallest of such statues, and had fallen 250 years ago. The pieces of the statue almost form a bridge between two mesas.

== Trivia ==
In Guild Wars, this statue was depicting a female warrior in Templar armor, but in Guild Wars 2 is depicting a male warrior in similar armor.

Communications Control is a point of interest within Rata Primus's Western Complex. This control center is visited during the story mission the Road to Rata Primus in order to access the top of the comm tower via the portal inside.

== Getting there ==
Communications Control can be found at the end of a tunnel north of the central intersection inside the Western Complex. This tunnel contains four sets of security barriers that can be opened by pressing the correct buttons on the security panels nearby. It is not required to unlock the fourth and final barrier to uncover the point of interest for map completion—approaching the control center will suffice.
The barriers can be unlocked by pressing the following buttons, numbered from left to right, on the security panels. They can be pressed
The Jemandi Market is a point of interest within the village of Atholma on the Sandswept Isles. It is located right next to the Atholma Waypoint.

Lab Sigma-05 is a point of interest in Calon Islet, on the eastern side of the Sandswept Isles. It can only be accessed via the Transport Facility Sigma-05, a hidden Inquest facility located in the Desert Highlands. The lab was used to study the effects of the Scarab Plague on local animals and the Olmakhan and as a storage for Exterminator Mark Golem pieces; it was destroyed in response to the Commander's intrusion. Volatile Magic can be found in the irradiated remains. This is the entrance through living story for the player.

== Notes ==
Radiation Poison is active while inside the lab, dealing 1000 damage per second to the player.
There are many volatile magic orbs inside the ruins.

The Iron Whale is a point of interest within the village of Atholma on the Sandswept Isles. It is the remnants of a giant, metal airship, and it has been refashioned as council hall for the Olmakhan elders.

== References ==

The Magistorm Gallery is a point of interest in the Eastern Complex area in the southern Sandswept Isles. It is a large open structure outside the Inquest main base, the upper levels supported by several sloped stone beams. Most of the Inquest personnel and machinery here can be defeated or destroyed to help the Olmakhan slow the Inquest's expansion.
Tunnel Access Epsilon is a point of interest in the Western Complex area in the southern Sandswept Isles. It serves as an entrance to the Western Complex from the Griffonstone Buttresses.
Tunnel Access Beta is a point of interest below the floating Rata Primus in the southern Sandswept Isles. It connects the central area of the Inquest base with the Western Complex.

The Ritual Grounds is a point of interest located on a small island southwest in the village of Atholma. This island is used by the Olmakhan villagers for ritual dances, and it is also where the Pact Commander is tested by the Olmakhan cubs during a Kindness Repaid.

Ewyn's Retreat is a point of interest up on the mountain in the center of the Hunting Grounds in the northern Sandswept Isles. Here, the Olmakhan Ewyn's hut can be found, as well as burial mounds of his deceased friends.

The Magnetics Lab is a point of interest within Invariant Enclave.

== Mechanics ==
This area has unique physics; for moving through the lab, take the Magneton Hammer and use the first skill available (Attractor Pulse) on Magneton Capacitors. Once used, they will attract you towards their location.
For example, using your skimmer mount will rapidly increase your altitude, and hovering can be used to rise faster, allowing you to collect particles easily.

== Notes ==
Gliding Disabled is in effect here; however, you will be immune to falling damage.
You are still able to use mounts, however. This is the only lab where they are authorized.
Tunnel Access Delta is a point of interest at the northern end of the southern Sandswept Isle. This gate here leads into the Western Complex of Rata Primus.

The Reserve Power Core is a point of interest at the Reserve Generator Site in the southern Sandswept Isles. It is a cube-shaped Inquest building with a shield cannon on top, which seems to be connected to the Necrobrand Emulation Lab via a piping system.
The Deepwater Cooling Sink is a point of interest right below the floating Rata Primus in the southern Sandswept Isles.

Skycavern Burial Grounds is a point of interest within The Hunting Grounds of the Sandswept Isles. The area consists of an open decorated cavern with several burial mounds where the Olmakhan come to mourn their dead. The entrance is located next to Greytear Falls.
The Driftwood Jetty is a point of interest at the northern end of the Strait of Panube on the Sandswept Isles.

The Necrobrand Emulation Lab is a point of interest in the Eastern Complex area in the southern Sandswept Isles. During the story mission the Road to Rata Primus the lab has to be entered in order to destroy the shield generator within, which maintains the shield around Rata Primus.

== Getting there ==
Follow the conveyor belt with the platforms transporting devourer corpses, then dodge the captive Branded Wyvern's projectile attack. Afterwards, successfully make your way through various steam geysers to access the generator.

== Notes ==
Mounts are forbidden within the lab, a message will display if you try to enter while mounting: "The Inquest have contaminated this area, making it inhospitable for mounts. You have been dismounted."

The Atholma Docks is a point of interest within the village of Atholma on the Sandswept Isles. It is located on a triangular platform above the water, west of the village.

== Trivia ==
This area was intended for the Roller Beetle, but the mount itself was released at a later date.

== References ==

Malor's Ranch is a point of interest within the The Ruined Paths in the northern Sandswept Isles. The ranch is only a short walk east from the Atholma Waypoint. Players can assist Malor with his farm here or help farmer Kian by defending the ranch from beetle attacks.

== Notes ==
There are several node farms of various plants here. They re-spawn as other nodes would. However, the second time you harvest in a collection of nodes, you can only harvest twice. The other nodes disappear after you harvest the second node (on the second spawn).

The Communications Array is a large Inquest tower on top of the Western Complex in the southern Sandswept Isles. During the story mission the Road to Rata Primus, the portal inside Communications Control has to be taken to get on top of this tower and sabotage it. The point of interest can be uncovered just by approaching the tower's base, though.
Tunnel Access Alpha is a point of interest below the floating Rata Primus in the southern Sandswept Isles. The tunnel leads from the center of the Inquest base north towards the Eastern Complex.

The Leyfinder Research Facility is a point of interest on Damos Isle—one of the southern Sandswept Isles. It is a large Inquest structure with a shield cannon on top. During the story mission The Road to Rata Primus, the lab has to be entered to destroy the shield generator within, which maintains part of the shield around Rata Primus.

== Getting there ==
This point of interest can be discovered either from the facility's roof or from within by using the ground-level entrance north of the facility.

== Notes ==
Mounts are forbidden within the lab, a message will display if you try to enter while mounting: "The Inquest have contaminated this area, making it inhospitable for mounts. You have been dismounted."

The Effluent Outflow Network is a point of interest near Damos Isle—one of the southern Sandswept Isles. It is a narrow canyon filled with several pipes that has to be traversed during the Skimmer race around Rata Primus.
Olma's Legacy is a point of interest in the Sandswept Isles. The area is dominated by a large statue of Olma, the presumed original leader of the Olmakhan. She is said to be the first Sandshifter.
The Greytear Falls is a point of interest at the eastern coast of the northern Sandswept Isles.

Tunnel Access Gamma is a point of interest in the Eastern Complex area in the southern Sandswept Isles. It connects the exterior part of the Eastern Complex with a tunnel that leads inside the base below Rata Primus.

The Cerberus Watchtowers is a point of interest on a floating Inquest platform high above the Griffonstone Buttresses. This location is most notable for being the arena for the Dominus Crystallum fight. The name likely refers to all three floating platforms due to the plural ending of "Watchtowers".

== Getting there ==
There are several ways to reach this point of interest:
There is a Sand Portal on the roof of the building south of the Communications Array (the large tower) which connects to the southernmost of the three floating platforms. From there, the Inquest Jump Pad leads up to the point of interest via a series of automatic jumps.
Instead of using the Sand Portal, there is also a jump pad over that building's roof, which can be reached with a Springer's High Vault from the small
Anniogel Landing is a point of interest at the Reserve Generator Site in the southern Sandswept Isles. It is a small Olmakhan encampment with a a Repair Anvil and a Bounty Board.

The Portalforge Lab is an Inquest lab inside the Invariant Enclave on the southernmost Sandswept Isle. As its name implies, this lab is used to experiment with non-asura gate portal technologies. The portal technology is very similar to the Interspatial Translocator and its stationary variant.
During the story mission the Road to Rata Primus, the lab has to be entered to destroy the shield generator within, which maintains part of the shield around Rata Primus.

== Getting there ==
The entrance to the lab is located at the northern end of the Invariant Enclaves' deck, on a downward sloping floor, roughly southwest of where the point of interest is seen on the map.

== Notes ==
Mounts are forbidden within the lab, a message will display if you try to enter while mounting: "The Inquest have

Specimen Chamber is a sealed chamber deep within Western Complex. It houses six powerful dragon minions, one pertaining to each Elder Dragon near Central Tyria, and one that holds the energy of multiple Elder Dragons. These dragon minions are the continued works of the Crucible of Eternity, the Inquest's attempts to create a dragon champion they can control. The lab supervisor is Overseer Kuda.

== Getting there ==
Players can only access this point of interest while the meta event The Specimen Chamber is active.

The Rata Primus Canal is a point of interest at the southern end of Rata Primus. It serves as an entrance to the Inquest base from the southern Sandswept Isles and has to be traverse during the Skimmer race around the area.

Zelbahn Garrison is a Point of Interest in the Allied Encampment. It is an Awakened stronghold that has been taken over by the allied forces in order to convert it into their local headquarters in the Domain of Kourna.
The Apizmic Grounds is a heket village led by Chieftain Xipil on the border of Bitterfly Bayou and Veldrunner Drifts, from where it often falls under attack by invading choya.

The Research Mainframe Access is an underground awakened Inquest facility located in the Dabiji Hollows. There, they are experimenting on the Scarab Plague. This location is only accessible by using the second Roller Beetle mastery Barrier Smash on a cliffside located at the summit of the plateau.

== Notes ==
Within the lab, a large containment cell with volatile magic can be found. The force field blocking access can be deactivated by hacking all the Inquest consoles around the lab.
Deeprift Brood is a point of interest in Ntouka Pond. This deep underwater pit is home to a colony of Cave Wurms.
The Western Allied Access is a point of interest located in the Western Front.
The Eastern Allied Access is a point of interest located in the Front Line. This vine barrier provides a gate between the Allied Encampment and the Front Line.

The Loyalist Warren is a point of interest in Ntouka Pond. It is a camp that was established in the small narrow canyons west of the Arkjok Farmlands by Joko Loyalists. They often conduct supply raids on Palawa's Benevolence.
Corsair Cannons is a point of interest in the Western Front. This trio of cannons is used by the shipwrecked corsairs to launch supplies over the thorn wall to the Allied Encampment.

The Bokoss Prison Ruins is a point of interest in the Eastern Front. It is connected to Gandara, the Moon Fortress by a bridge. While it was still operational, it was used to hold Kourna's most important enemies, including the human turned goddess Kormir.

The Dunlon Springs is a point of interest in the Yohlon Bluffs. It is a small oasis and waterfall tucked away behind a series of cliffs. It can be accessed either by following the river up from the Elon Basin or bash down the wall blocking access to the springs with the Roller Beetle. The gap above the wall can also be cleared with the help of the springer or the griffon.
A mastery point can be found in the waters guarded by several Elonian skales. The oasis also features two Kournan Chests, one in the north and one in the east. The eastern chest is protected by a Veteran Water Djinn and two Ice Imps that spawn on approach.
The Dejarin Ruins is a point of interest in the Veldrunner Drifts. Here lies the remains of the once Dejarin Estate, now half buried in sand and only inhabited by roaming elementals.

Research Vault Beta is an underground Awakened Inquest facility located in the Dabiji Hollows. There, they are experimenting on the Scarab Plague and rats.

== Getting there ==
This location is only accessible during the event   Help Researcher Emm track the origin point of the mutated rats (80).

== Related achievements ==
 Long Live the Lich: Thing That Wouldn't Leave — Overstay your welcome in the Awakened Inquest plague research lab. (1)
Stay inside the lab after completing the event; after a few minutes the door will close and you will be teleported to a random location and receive the achievement.

The Pogahn Bluffs Proving Ground is a cliffside cave Awakened Inquest facility located in the Dabiji Hollows. There, they are experimenting on members from the local heket tribe.

== Getting there ==
You'll find the cave entrance after getting to the top of the cliffs near the POI marker on your map.

== Notes ==
During the Roller Beetle collection, you can interact with the Inquest Console and hack them.
One of the cells is empty and can be entered.

== Trivia ==
The name of the facility is a reference to the Guild Wars outpost Pogahn Passage.

The Wreck of the Scimitar is a point of interest in the Corsair Landing. This ship was part of the corsair fleet that joined the allied forces until it was sunk by the Awakened army, forcing the survivors onto land south of the thorn wall and exposing them to the dangers of the Scarab Plague.
Idol of the Choya is a point of interest within the Kodonur Crossing. It is a rock formation where many Choya and Rhythmic Choya gather around and dance.
The Barbellate Crater is a point of interest in Kodonur Crossing. This deep crater is inhabited by a large group of Spotted Hyenas.

Gandara Main Approach is a point of interest located in the Front Line. It is the main entrance to Gandara, the Moon Fortress and is heavily defended by a pair of imposing towers surrounding the bridge which leads to the sturdy gate.
Gandara Western Approach is a point of interest in the Front Line.

The Secret Throughway is a point of interest in Ntouka Pond. It is an enclosed tunnel linking Ntouka Pond to the rest of the surrounding lands. It can only be accessed and passed through by bashing down the walls with the help of the Roller Beetle.
Palawa's Benevolence is a point of interest and human village in the Arkjok Farmlands.
Arkjok Kennels is a point of interest within the Arkjok Farmlands. The village's basenjis are kept there.

Research Vault Alpha is an underground awakened Inquest facility located in the Dabiji Hollows. There, they are experimenting on the Scarab Plague.

== Getting there ==
The entrance is hidden behind a holographic stone wall, which can be disabled by pressing the grey stone panel on the cliffside near the entrance. Hugging the wall will also attain the PoI.
		
		
		

== Notes ==
Entering the lab by pressing the stone button will trigger the corresponding event   Clear out the Awakened Inquest lab (80).
It is possible to activate the point of interest from outside the lab on top of the mountain by passing just south of the it on the map.

The Imperial Center for Applied Pestilence is a point of interest in Gandara, the Moon Fortress. The main labs conducting research on the Scarab Plague are found here.

== Notes ==
Once the Champion Awakened Lead Researcher is killed, an Access Card is received which can be consumed to allow access to a blocked off room filled with Kournan Chests. To access the treasure room, you have to enter another room on the other side of the stairs and use the portal there. From the stairs (facing away from them) go to the left. Enter the first room on the right (with the glowing red "windows"). Step onto the hexagon at the far end of the room.
It is only available once the Scarab Plague meta-event is complete.
Crocuta Vantage is a point of interest in the Elon Basin. This small cave and overlook are inhabited by a group of Spotted Hyenas.

The Gaze of the Ancients is a point of interest located in the center of the Reclaimed Chantry. Five statues of the Six Human Gods can be seen gazing at this central point. The lone statue of Kormir is located up the hill and is staring at a different location.

Displaced Vizier's Tower is a copy of The Vizier's Tower as it was during the Human-charr conflict in 1071 AE, shortly before The Cataclysm. It was created by the Mists and displaced into Jahai Bluffs by the Elder Dragon Kralkatorrik's new powers creating tears between the world and the Mists. At the base of the tower, two armies led by Imperator Ventus and Lieutenant Nerise are in constant, repeating, battle.

== Getting there ==
Basic mounts route: Springer up the gold pillar north-north-east of the central tower, then clamber up the cliffs in the north-east corner. Use a raptor to leap to the northern tower (visited during the story). Again use a raptor canyon leap to reach the top of the central tower. It is also possible to use the raptor only by jumping on the rocks to the west of th
Staging Platform is a point of interest within Almorra's Stand in Jahai Bluffs. It is where General Almorra Soulkeeper assembles a team to Destroy the Death-Branded Shatterer.
Jahai Great Hall is a point of interest in the Fortress of Jahai.

Ring of Judgment is a point of interest in the Fortress of Jahai.

== Notes ==
Champion Judge Aasma, part of the Big Bluffs Hunter achievement, spawns here.

Claw Den is a point of interest within Shattered Cliffs. It is located high above the valley floor and is infested with branded foes. It is the end point for Ziya the Radiant's chain of events which begin with Defend Ziya as she searches for Vemyen.
Riyid's Post is a point of interest within Rilohn River in Jahai Bluffs.

The Fortress Courtyard is a point of interest in the Jahai Keep. 

== Getting there ==
There are several ways to reach this location:
Automatically, during the story step A Shattered Nation
While the Inner Keep race event is active, which runs every 30 minutes.
By entering the cave slightly north of the vista in Yatendi Village and hugging the wooden gate. This cave is due west of the Fortress Courtyard, however the point of interest will probably be hidden until you unlock it.
Sleepless Beacon is a point of interest within Prosperity's Approach. It was a beacon marking the way to Crescent's Prosperity village.

Ancestor Tree was a sacred tree to the Veldrunner centaurs. Some scholars believed that the fruit of these trees was considered divine and as a way to pass on spiritual wisdom from one generation to the next. Now all that is left of them is this tree.
It has its own meta event.
Battleground Ramparts is a point of interest within Almorra's Stand in Jahai Bluffs. It is where the Death-Branded Shatterer spawns during Destroy the Death-Branded Shatterer.
Garrison Relay Tower is a point of interest in the Argon Garrison.
Noble's Walk is a point of interest in the Fortress of Jahai.
Wurmmarshal's Encampment is a point of interest in Wurmhaven.

Rilohn Falls is a point of interest in the Fortress of Jahai.

== Notes ==
Underneath the waterfall there is a secret cave that can be accessed with the roller beetle's Barrier Smash skill. Inside there are two Jahai Bluffs Chests.
Confluence of the Elements is a point of interest in Kodonur Temple.
Archon's Retreat is a point of interest in the Fortress of Jahai.
Garrison Command is a point of interest in the Argon Garrison.
Garrison Access Tower is a point of interest in the Argon Garrison.

Vanguard Ordinance is a point of interest in Pact Vanguard.

== Notes ==
Presumably intended to be named "Vanguard Ordnance", as this is clearly a military equipment depot (where "ordnance" is stored), and not a municipal law or regulation (which is what an "ordinance" is).

Kormir's Reverence is a statue of Kormir located in the southwestern area of the Reclaimed Chantry. This statue sits apart from the other statues of the Six Human Gods, and can be knelt at to summon Nenah.

Mirza's Rest is a point of interest in Venta Pass.

== Trivia ==
The location is likely named after Mirza Veldrunner, leader of the centaur Veldrunner pride from the time of Nightfall.
Vanguard Salvage Yard is a point of interest in Pact Vanguard.

liPOIs.strName: Monument to the Return of Palawa Joko
liPOIs.strWikiText:
Monument to the Return of Palawa Joko is a point of interest in the Central Brand Scar. Originally a monument dedicated to the defeat of Palawa Joko by Turai Ossa in 862 AE during the Battle of Jahai, as well Joko's tomb sealed by the Order of Whispers, it has been renamed during Joko's reign over Elona.

== References ==
The now-Branded Yatendi Farm is a point of interest within Eastern Brand Scar.

Crystal Cavern may refer to:
Crystal Cavern (Jahai Bluffs) — a point of interest in Jahai Bluffs.
Crystal Cavern (Gyala Delve) — a point of interest in Gyala Delve.
Chaos Crystal Cavern — a Jumping Puzzle in Iron Marches
Wyvern Roost is a point of interest in the Jungle Anomaly.
Crescent's Town Hall is a point of interest within Crescent's Prosperity.
Mist Warden Outpost is a point of interest within Mist Warden Camp, hosting the Mist Warden forces.

The Crystal Cudgel is Kralkatorrik's tail. It occasionally moves, slamming the ground and sending out Branded lines of spikes when it lands. At the end of the meta when Kralkatorrik creates a carapace, the tail is also covered in crystal. 

== Trivia ==
Standing on the tail when it moves will launch you high into the air.
Olmakhan Outpost is a point of interest within Olmakhan Camp.

Tower of the Third is a point of interest, marking an ancient tree in the basin of Melandru's Chalice.

== Trivia ==
The name might refer to the claim made in the Orrian History Scrolls that Melandru was the third of the Six Human Gods to arrive on Tyria.

Shackled Grasp is a point of interest within Dragon's Snare. It marks a weak spot on Kralkatorrik near one of his claws. In the story step Bleed in War Eternal, this point is used to test a True Dragonsblood Spear on Kralkatorrik. This point of interest is available even when the Brandstorm over Kralkatorrik's main body is still present during the early parts of the meta.

The Skyscale Eyrie is small cave, where you first meet Skyscales during the story. It's located south of  The Underworld Waypoint — .

== Notes ==
After finishing the War Eternal story, Gorrik will be here to start the Skyscale mount collection, Newborn Skyscales.
Grenth's Respite marks a large statue of Grenth near the bridge spanning the area between the Underworld and Melandru's Lost Domain.
The Charnel Gate is a gate at Pact Command that leads to the Olmakhan Camp in the southwest of Dragonfall.
The Chaos Gate marks the southwest entrance to the cave that goes between the Olmakhan Camp and Pact Command. The ground near this area is Branded, possibly due to being beneath Kralkatorrik's wing.
Balthazar's Folly is a point of interest within Crystal Bloom Camp which marks a fallen statue of Balthazar on the edge of the Burning Forest landmass.
Pact Outpost is a point of interest within Pact Command, hosting the Pact and other allied forces.
Crystal Bloom Outpost is a point of interest within Crystal Bloom Camp.
The Loathsome Pulpit features a statue of Grenth surrounded by pillars, almost like a classroom.
The Ashen Steppes are a series of tall cliffs layered over one another, creating a small steppe structure in the Burning Forest.
The Wailing Basin marks the location of several lower areas (basins) which emit ethereal blue smoke and an otherworldy wailing noise.
Verdance Falls is a point of interest in Melandru's Chalice. It is a large waterfall that feeds the chalice.
The Trail of Cinder is the easiest trail into the Burning Forest among the high cliff faces that face the Dragon's Causeway and Pact Command.
The Fire God's Precipice is the edge of the Burning Forest landmass that faces the Underworld landmass at Ember Gate.
The Airdrome Port is where airships can dock at Pact Command in Dragonfall.
The Verdant Gate is a gate at Pact Command that leads to the Melandru's Lost Domain via a bridge that leads into The Skein.

Ember Gate is an area within Dragonfall to the northwest.

== Locations and objectives ==
Points of Interest
 Fire God's Precipice — 
Events

The Earthen Shrine sits in the center of a pool of quicksand. It initially appears as a small raised section in the center of the sand but upon walking closer more platforms appear. The center stones have moss growing on them.
The Gates of Ahdashim is the entry point to the Leystone Axis and the inner areas of the Great City of Ahdashim. It was previously watched over by the Key of Ahdashim prior to  Qadim's intrusion.
The Well of Ahdashim sits as an observation point to the Sovereign's Stadium's center. Entering the well removes your armor.

The Key's Fountain sits in the center of the Leystone Axis. It serves as a center point in the entryway to the city and restores the form of the Key of Ahdashim after Qadim scattered it across the Prism Sanctuary.
Nirvana's Ascent sits at the bottom of a leyline with many floating platforms rising up from the damaged ground.

River's Provenance is located in Winter's Vigil in the Hall of Chains. From this area, the Soulless Horror lays siege on the Besieged Ruins. Additionally, it is also the starting point for the River of Souls.
Besieged Ruins is located in Winter's Vigil in the Hall of Chains. Souls take refuge within the ruins from the Soulless Horror and other local threats.
The Statue of Darkness is one of three Grenth statues corrupted by Dhuum in the Hall of Chains. The corruption is cleansed as part of the Statues of Grenth encounter.

The Statue of Ice is one of three Grenth statues corrupted by Dhuum in the Hall of Chains. The corruption is cleansed as part of the Statues of Grenth encounter. The Broken King stands guard at the base of this statue.

The Statue of Death and Resurrection is one of three Grenth statues corrupted by Dhuum in the Hall of Chains. The corruption is cleansed as part of the Statues of Grenth encounter. An Eater of Souls guards it.

Hall of Judgment (Domain of Istan)
Hall of Judgment (Hall of Chains)

The River of Souls is a flow of spirits traveling through the Underworld and Realm of Torment. It has recently been redirected by Dhuum to empower him and give him the strength to break free into Tyria. During Nightfall, it was redirected in the Realm of Torment by Dhuum's forces aiding Abaddon to feed their demonic armies.

== See also ==
Soul River Glider
Soul River Hound Hammer Skin
The Acquisition Portal is the entrance for things coming into the Mystic Forge.
The Reliquary Bridge leads through the Grand Causeway to the Mythwright Cauldron.

The Mystic Clover Garden is where Zommoros collects the Mystic Clovers which have been thrown into the Mystic Forge.

== Getting there ==
Two sand portals lead into the garden, one portal in each room horizontally next to the  Ectoplasmic Containment —  room:
The northeastern portal in the western room.
The western portal in the eastern room.
Which doesn't work if you have "Clear out the ectoplasm" instead of "Shrink and sort the megapets".

The center of the Mythwright Cauldron, with a series of 12 triangular floating platforms above that ordinarily form a hexagonal star shape.

== Notes ==
This is the location of the boss fight with Qadim.

The Miniature-Pet Menagerie is where Zommoros keeps his mini-pet collection.

== Trivia ==
Zommoros's experiments here have led to the unwelcome & hostile "megapets", such as Mega Chainsaw the Skeleton, Mega Maraca Choya Pinata, Mega Foostivoo the Merry, and Mega Princess Doll.

Ectoplasmic Containment is where Globs of Ectoplasm end up in the Mystic Forge.

== Trivia ==
The globs occasionally collect to form semi-sentient, hostile masses such as the Ectoplasmic Conglomeration.

The Private Reserve is Zommoros's private study.

== Notes ==
It is not actually that private as the Mystic Forge's skritt regularly enter and exit the room. Another such room exists that contains the Mystic Forge Contract that the skritt do not enter.

Mine may refer to:
Gathering from ore nodes using a mining pick.
Guild Mine in Guild halls.
A location (POI, area, etc.) on the map (examples: Blackhold Mine Camp or Dissun's Mine).
A skill (examples: Throw Mine or Shrapnel Mine).
An object (example: Mine Seed)
